The vice president of law and policy at the Voting Rights Lab has come out and said it -- voting rights experts expect to see continued attempts to restrict voting and the activities of voter outreach groups in states controlled by opponents of voting rights.
“ The effort to target third-party voter registration groups is just, unfortunately, one of many policy areas that state legislatures are moving to address ,” she said.
We can't do our work without your help, and we can't push back alone. RUSH $25 or more right now to fight these suppressive laws and make sure eligible voters are able to register >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092824_4&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=092824_4&amount=25]
AP: Voter outreach groups targeted by new laws in several GOP-led states are struggling to do their work [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=092824_4&amount=25]
Team: if you've been with us for a while, you know all about the voter suppression laws passed in states like Florida, Georgia, Texas, and more.
Among the new, suppressive restrictions on drop boxes, mail-in voting, line warming, and other tools that help people vote came another -- tight restrictions on 3rd party groups like ours that help register new voters and deep penalties against 3rd party voter registration groups for their work.
The bad news? It's working . Florida's law in particular has curtailed pro-voter organizations from hiring staff and helping people register to vote. It's also led to a downturn in their fundraising, making it harder for them to do their other work to defend voting rights.
Instead of coordinating volunteers to go door-to-door ahead of the election or sending them to events around these states to help register eligible voters, organizations like ours are stuck trying to figure out how to help people vote without incurring $250,000 fines. It's plainly unacceptable.

➜ New restrictions on mail-in voting
➜ New legal limits on organizations that help register new voters
➜ Onerous new restrictions for first-time voters
➜ New requirements for "voter list maintenance" (which is code for scrubbing the voter rolls)
The NAACP Florida State Conference argued that these measures “ make it harder for Floridians to register and vote, and undermine Florida’s election administration .” The president of the League of Women Voters in Florida said the law stripped the personal connection between its workers and communities.
One of the leaders of MOVE Texas, another voting rights group, said “ The [Texas] law contributed to this culture of fear in our elections and being a person who registers voters .”

body:
I just made a very difficult decision
_[Click here to stop receiving emails about Dan Osborn's campaign in Nebraska from us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93810977/501686520/1647001491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNjg1NmZjMi1mNTdkLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PLYpN0HAyrTOFa_EAFAt0m230wIRTHkDJHphY3aRB5I=&emci=12ab402e-487d-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e6856fc2-f57d-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=19445147)_
Hello,
After seven new polls showed me neck-and-neck with my opponent Republican Deb Fischer here in Nebraska’s Senate race, Fischer’s campaign and Mitch McConnell's Super PACs bought over $3.6 MILLION in new TV ads attacking me.
Fischer and McConnell have begun absolutely blanketing the state with TV ads, attacking me with ridiculous lies. We have an opportunity to win Nebraska’s Senate seat – but only if we can counter the lies and match them on the air.
**That’s why I just made a very difficult decision and told my campaign we could begin airing more of our own TV ads to fight back, even though we don’t _technically_ have all the money in our budget to do so just yet.**
We’re taking this risk because we have to. Nebraska is now the closest Senate race in the entire country according to researchers at Princeton University. **So I made an executive decision and took a bet that grassroots donors like you would come through and help us fill our $100,000 budget gap...**
We need to do everything we can if we’re going to win this Senate seat and elect a blue-collar worker to be the 51st vote in the U.S. Senate. That means taking a few risks.

I’ve said this before, but I truly can’t say it enough times: I am so grateful to have you as a part of this team.
I know all the fundraising emails get to be pretty tedious this time of year. But with our race tied, extremist groups spending big to attack me, and the House majority riding on the outcome, please know that your support is what allows me to make my case to voters — and put together the coalition we’ll need to win an extremely hard-fought election on November 5th.
Thanks again for all you do, and have a great rest of your night.

So they will attack and attack and attack her relentlessly. Just like they attack me.

Hey Peter, Jon Tester here.

I’m not like most of my colleagues in the Senate, and it’s not too hard to see why. All you have to do is look at my $12 flattop haircut and my collection of dirt-stained t-shirts.

**I’m the Senate’s only working farmer, and damn proud of it.**

Yes, it can make for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons—but it keeps me grounded, and gives me a unique perspective on issues. Like how climate change affects my farm, or how rural communities like mine need high-speed internet.

**These are real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. But political experts rank my seat as one of the most likely to flip red, so I need your help to beat the odds and win this critical race:**

For New Mexico,

**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Dr. Kristin Hook
subject: September Campaign Updates
body:
| | | | | [](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=15db32688b&e=395a33a3d2)

| | | | |
# Less than 40 Days Until Election Day!
---
| It’s hard to believe how close we are to Election Day, and there has been no shortage of activity here on the campaign this past month!
On Labor Day, I joined the [North East Bexar County Democrats](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=bbbf869b68&e=395a33a3d2) for their annual picnic, where we heard fromTX Rep. [James Talarico](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=730d5d39f7&e=395a33a3d2) – a former middle school teacher and shining example of a public servant fighting for all of us!
---
| Like Rep. Talarico, I know the important role that education and educators play in our state. That is why I was delighted to have the opportunity to meet with the [Kendall County Retired Teachers Association](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=dec9847b94&e=395a33a3d2)for their fall luncheon on September 12th in Boerne!
On September 14th, I headed to Bandera and had a FANTASTIC time meeting with the Bandera County Democratic Club for their monthly meeting and potluck!
---
| On September 17th, Beto O’Rourke held a [Powered By People](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=f3a760741a&e=395a33a3d2) rally at Texas State, where 300 students mobilized in excitement for our upcoming election!Here’s what he had to say about our race...
---
[](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=cca50d6f6d&e=395a33a3d2)
| What an honor to be recognized by a change makerwho has truly done so much for our state!
And speaking of change makers,I am so excited to announce that I have been endorsed by U.S. Representative Lloyd Doggett!
---
| Like so many others, Rep. Doggett is ready to Flip Chip, and I can’t wait to work alongsidehim in Congress to make healthcare more accessible and affordable for Texas families!
In addition to 16 Meet & Greets and countless doors knocked this month, I also had two editorial board interviews and was featured in the [Houston Chronicle](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=26d63fc652&e=395a33a3d2), and on [Texas Public Radio](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=74c1eb7e32&e=395a33a3d2)!
It’s been a September to remember, with a few more rallies, meet & greets, and blockwalks to go until we close out the month.
Over the coming weeks we will continue ramping upblock walks throughout the district – [**sign up to blockwalk here**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=dd4c132381&e=395a33a3d2) to get involved and show your support!
THANK YOU SO MUCH to every supporter and volunteer who has _already_ gotten involved in our campaign – we truly couldn’t stay in this fight without you!
I hope to see you out on the campaign trail soon!
---
| [P.S. We have just THREE days left until](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=6b5042ae53&e=395a33a3d2)[the next end-of-quarter filing deadline!!!](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=422c7d7ad2&e=395a33a3d2)[Can you pitch in $25 or whatever makes sense](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=24f46db24c&e=395a33a3d2)[for you to help us reach our fundraising goal?](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=c1ff8fa259&e=395a33a3d2)

_* Sent in support of Elissa Slotkin for Michigan and Lucas Kunce for Missouri *_
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74124?refcode=em20240928-7835&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7835%2E614464%2ECcG1JX)
Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges — from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:
**[Can I count on you to contribute $5, $20 or whatever feels right to you today directly to Lucas Kunce and Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan? Friends, I was hoping to catch you before you logged off for the day. I'm writing to ask for your support, but first, I want to share something. My upbringing taught me a fundamental lesson: If you put in the effort, your chance at success should be just as good as anyone else's. These values, instilled by my hardworking parents — a union lineman and an automobile tire factory worker — drive my commitment to a better future for New Mexico. Our campaign is rooted in our fight for a future where reproductive rights are protected, public lands are preserved, and good-paying jobs are abundant. But right now, this vision is at risk. _**BUT, I am worried that the American Dream is slipping away.**_**Career politicians like my opponent Bob Casey and Kamala Harris are doing NOTHING to stop inflation, allowing rampant crime to go unchecked, and allowing dangerous drugs to cross our borders in excess.** Their policies have made America weaker, and I can’t sit back and let that happen. clean_body: Peter, With time running out before my final FEC end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day, I'm asking you to take three minutes to read my message below. I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end. Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old. I’m so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg. It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War. The small rural town of Bloomsburg shaped who I am. I'm proud to be a 7th -generation Pennsylvanian and I'm ready to get to work to help the great people of our state. All this is to say, I've lived the American Dream, and I am so grateful for the opportunities that America and Pennsylvania have afforded me. BUT, I am worried that the American Dream is slipping away.Career politicians like my opponent Bob Casey and Kamala Harris are doing NOTHING to stop inflation, allowing rampant crime to go unchecked, and allowing dangerous drugs to cross our borders in excess. [**Will you please split a donation of $5 or more today between my campaign and Jacky Rosen's to help us get our fundraising back on track so I can keep fighting for you in Washington?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93812609/501726746/1743277108?&amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4982-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZmE0NjhjOS0xMzdlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lMgJxg_FyMA9rJvHcsdyT4Ahhjy4pgaRYSoZM7DzzKc=)

That means standing up to anybody who tries to get in the way of improving health care for veterans, lowering prescription drug costs, or protecting Medicare and Social Security. Because these aren't just abstract issues or talking points. These are things that will make a very real difference for the people in Montana and across the country, and that's what I'm fighting for in Washington.

subject: It Is Time To Reclaim Our Democracy.

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us21.campaign-archive.com/?e=5d7e9a146c&u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=9026074714)

# It's time to reclaim our democracy.

The Citizens United ruling opened the floodgates for unlimited corporate spending in our elections. Since then, billionaires and special interests have gained outsized influence over our political system, drowning out the voices of everyday Americans. We need to overturn Citizens United and put an end to the idea that corporations are people with the same rights as individuals. Our elections should reflect the will of the people—not the wallets of the wealthiest few.
Let’s stand together for real campaign finance reform, transparency, and a political system where everyone has an equal voice. It’s time to make our democracy work for all of us again.

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zeu9qrqag4o8mmkgajjamm5f5dff37trt9km5f78_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cdg6eor6cth2bs) [NO](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpgo5bfqioiaddotgpm4b9ir7uif8qjoeoavuv2g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cdg6eor6cth2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zb4miq2skhqhc8h1ast00agkjo9pveqku748860o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cdg6eor6cth2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fc2c99f635ea4ac4bbc734844194c56e&_e=CDmePdsi7XlPc3wxdlaLtEdJH-uBLjRpGUflHKGHZx2L3Z7L3o7FoaxMOsBm5qsmlzALNtirsJuPcdOnfhe117AdOzHv4shllsA7Fxrpfl2K30_VOqKMJYfl9q-8_UikUPo0PoEoJj98dkUucGUOiSv84hbziAW6JQrL6cuet6h-JL1Gmh_p-fu-Mw86T2RWORt_zRGMYQ4IOXF0hYWG13NVFYl2l-kBwzYC-ziu-d_6QaZBox38CVDfXCxzZdQJeeIpjzx4a8yyqbRkmcFAOi9D5oLPSUsNTiu2HPFqLZ-RdA1Flu9aA5cjdsQvdu5uQFOKqdtZleV_5BgEJuG47C6E02Nb0J-fXTlwD9fJQldmMjBFRft6aF2ukP_AZ-Ff1a0c26KyRP9b5os4U8Lqfw%3D%3D)
---
| | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fc2c99f635ea4ac4bbc734844194c56e&_e=CDmePdsi7XlPc3wxdlaLtEdJH-uBLjRpGUflHKGHZx2L3Z7L3o7FoaxMOsBm5qsmlzALNtirsJuPcdOnfhe117AdOzHv4shllsA7Fxrpfl2K30_VOqKMJYfl9q-8_UikUPo0PoEoJj98dkUucGUOiSv84hbziAW6JQrL6cuet6h-JL1Gmh_p-fu-Mw86T2RWORt_zRGMYQ4IOXF0hYWG13NVFYl2l-kBwzYC-ziu-d_6QaZBox38CVDfXCxzZdQJLXDSpGziAmLauEDJw4u-bLNXc_u1OLBqVEGb178vu0R4K_WhfYjTApaFTZQ7ce0avtduHJh6B3n98Pq5Q8_ekYXNQKrzWN066wzhqSa0MPUePaIPdoJ4p_CqBLcspSk5oZrEp1ywOEyBA7gvxIfThA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5b2c6a70b0744ebbae17b8cb2daacd4c&_e=CDMcjydk4pnDybKVwp86Mfyo_D9g0qkFrMNJRBg_AbZQu5kPjlCkjMxC-e4SWXzTgXlnLdokW96lpWn2bzfhyXz1RZHskPSlLC7LZRoHvGaQjda_3Mx_15Kzssjzaq1zji-uuO-uzVlAB5RblrUdu-FT7bvnqS8LNh1SR_pC49ZzSoDuHVGulGQlro1F4SpRiD7P5JWOjSKsPovcletuzcxm3ZANQ-ZCt6haMOJcdEsrAi1ui1D-OJtNTLoH5kSFvv-_KYGTN1UweOb4gB61okp8jGiDfnbCyKRUARZADcjMi3_ZHNtq9JGQSlsIOvOeSMu4FDQFT4UEono0KPsQDOfnt7zVJAlvldDM7fBC66gjiidcerBUDqqaOzNFjUC_ligEti-1AV6WC56FHHwsSzJ5LJOO_zYQpJCkAbBDvYk%3D) [NO](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5b2c6a70b0744ebbae17b8cb2daacd4c&_e=CDMcjydk4pnDybKVwp86Mfyo_D9g0qkFrMNJRBg_AbZQu5kPjlCkjMxC-e4SWXzTgXlnLdokW96lpWn2bzfhyXz1RZHskPSlLC7LZRoHvGaQjda_3Mx_15Kzssjzaq1zji-uuO-uzVlAB5RblrUdu-FT7bvnqS8LNh1SR_pC49ZzSoDuHVGulGQlro1F4SpRiD7P5JWOjSKsPovcletuzcxm3ZANQ-ZCt6haMOJcdEsrAi1ui1D-OJtNTLoH5kSFvv-_KYGTN1UweOb4gB61okdoAbp_6oUqE4jBHBbJot_4Gz9t7NgGy6l8QX0qPtiWQSs5l3Ufkg9ggnbhcpZBZP1nT2ZDSOETXxOBl-2oEPKUeoT_EJQ1Cketg0MwN9x0i5Gti0T3-Idp7dcQxladwF3rojnmHaRa3B9seOofK_s%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. ## Israel Kills Hezbollah Leader Nasrallah
[Israel has killed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQxvGnwZstOOPYDAyVKksd0rWjdZhzfA2BCGii9OmrZO76fctP_6_jckQOHE-feCFbt7TgWvlGi2nBtKAX3Xi7EQH1DVk1wnhQ02CmZrfD5jz6YR3WwQ_bdJAKldSrNyQ9IJiGLUjQ0oBRUo5gumGatEQ3Sd8713sQWpLnmnL3nTjWnbbwSDfK3ZouTbB7rdci-jcBs4AZ3RrpXrpTet4C5o9YKUesnCIGAfNOvy6FgHsbCD3ldsdSMLYRS8bXfuYQyLeOOP_UFjmXmvlMRcBcasoP0c_sRf-ulO7VU9xk6693DoHLYRRani7I4aWr_7e6WfgLAAD__wdWbYw) Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah and other key commanders in targeted airstrikes in Beirut, Lebanon. Hezbollah confirmed their longtime leader's death Saturday. Iranian general Abbas Nilforoushan was also killed in the attack. Israel said it conducted strikes on 140 Hezbollah targets overnight and into Saturday morning. Israeli Defense Forces indicated that "[precise intelligence](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAURL8Gd7aurzGGguI1dHntlhaYS8wuCRGwsbJfv3Lq7Y40R5rRfFzWi40p3q__7Y10C3m1W4tPWlWPqke-8s7rQIQ0daTHBRcxylnJbtejoACT97MUNLoQNpiCIyEsCXQkti5qBOSgUI0AC6phlpKDdRL85NzkkXEgH1suw2eO97ZTSK_8pDJs-dYlvbf2qGz6x9AwNMdxDN_Vtuzt6xQYmtpyeTE0dzrqaeSSPENztjI0oE6WZ25rsSnZvd_px-U3fcWUyPexFkuJoVlmPko5coCFoemK9o8jphSrWBiH683G9J7V_j7pqfE3AAD__7-nZ48)" led to the strike on Nasrallah in Hezbollah's "Central Headquarters," located beneath a residential building. The death of Hezbollah's top official drastically escalates tensions in the Middle East, with Iran's Ayatollah Khamenei calling the strike "criminal" and saying Israel would "regret its actions."
## 425,000 Criminal Illegal Immigrants Free in U.S.
Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) released a new report Friday indicating that over [425,000 illegal immigrants](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQxvGn0W4dWEGloEhjd2lTOqirtwnCDRDNvX3mUqf-fcU3_4_bdHPsOezv7iBbtji5pfBJkwE0gGpS9Wo3IqS2Jit77Ds5aDPUd9tvujWtJilN5yRJ1IMktUktnNDd2tZsUaASBo0UokfT6GFQws2DWNt5bleslKCVS0zNZ-RQ7rT5ZzwpNUs8am_vpTxy1b5VOFY4XtfVbPEn0JVfXuF40MquwjFQuWL6AjopcNjhNVlcLhlml8g_4aBQOIYXAC8EiR4xFVCohRCwJD44OA8H78mFkmFLRPANuU52fVzsPeeur5TYD8f-71z5P9Vp8TcAAP__lSJtWQ) who have been convicted of crimes are currently free in the U.S., rising from the 405,000 mark in 2021. Over 13,000 of the "non-detained" immigrants have been [convicted of homicide](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L-upSAQgPGn0Q6DA_6hoNjG7my7pRlh0NkgnAirOW-_ube-9dd8-f15rS_kyGn_jSfZGvKKrvJNqxFgBOhVt94GIiDVku0nmMZ-HszcHnYIHsJIDo3egpMIk-kJMJAf_TYrbNmCBC0NmF7KCUw3zLOWuM3Sq21THhotyXPNV_c3c6oHhfjJN12dy2cb7VHruzTqVwNLA8vzPF3aXKKnfPUGFk43lco7Vs6pNLD0Skop-Dx5vzDVIlxON7tKXhz5ZMeeROSb0y7CRRQ_4l8R7Eh4rCgul7CfVA9De1n_fjhGLuPUaLmfyPF7qv5MdFv4HwAA__-17Gtn). 62,231 have been convicted of assault and 14,301 of burglary. The report came on that same day that Vice President Harris made a [rare visit to the border](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FurDAQAL_G7g6t1-aMCxevobvXpkQGr489GYzAgiRfH13qdCONNNJ8PIZH4Mzr839YyNdUhjBVPmlwN3Q3NIOR0SciJC3JK4v2rrrWdXL2CMZQggBgkzKgWhehRUwKW0QbnWSPgAYcOgVg0TVt1xkIYwdRj6OOKAxQ5Fr25lV4rTOl_FVO2pupLDL7udbtEPqfwF5gf11XM47T2wnsV7oOgX3YK0-Z3jiRe33q703ppcjdx-3inPm4W2HguQTOv9X69-Pp8ScAAP__rIRSEg), as border security remains one of the most pivotal issues in the presidential election.
## List: When Billionaires Could Become Trillionaires
It's one thing to be a billionaire, but when will the world see a trillionaire? [According to a new study](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL8GOtCy-MAuXKS57tKmRMZew0YGn2APlL-PuCpF2pmn0eh9PYaH48Tr9OkWshLz4LzwQYOp0FSoBlUGG4mQ2pJs02PfNfpmdDlb73uvoQXvAPUNO993weiIsVGoCWLJFgEVGDQNQI-mvmmtwI0aQjuObcBCAQWWvNXfmVeZKaaffNBW-7yUyc4iz71oPwq8F3g_z7M-eH-55N2TxSXe5QKvaqa18vmVQjVySpxXxxvt1Ug-L1TJ9id8j7VTzlOi4eBpJREqNxue50XtXV8omBbH6f1C_ndyWPwNAAD__-sHZsc), Elon Musk could become the world's first trillionaire by 2027. The study indicates he would be followed by three more trillionaires in 2028 with India's Gautam Adani, American Jensen Huang, and Indonesia's Prajogo Pangestu. The world's second richest person currently, Frenchman Bernard Arnault, is set to reach trillionaire status in 2030. These projections are based on annual average fortune growth from 2017 to 2024. Friend, I’m in the business of history. I have devoted decades of my life to making films that tell America’s stories and remind people of our vast and complicated past so we can better understand where our nation is – and, perhaps more importantly, where we are going.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the global conflicts of the First and Second World Wars to the darkest days of the COVID-19 pandemic, these pivotal moments have tested our republic and forced us to reckon with the promise that defines the fabric of our nation – the responsibility to preserve a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all of its citizens.
In November, our country faces another crossroads, and to me, this is a choice that could not be clearer. The democratic principles that have long been the bedrock of our nation are at risk, and the results of the November elections will have profound consequences for each of our futures.
**That’s why I’m reaching out to you today to ask for[ _your support_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93819690/501734848/1399008008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4786-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMTA5ZjMwYi01YjdlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P4Jn8Y1nIZGDWKjCheEg1JuSl3Hk__il8VgJz-4j164=) in reelecting Senator Jacky Rosen in one of the most competitive battleground states in 2024.**
We need leaders like Jacky in the Senate, who will tirelessly fight for hardworking families across the country, defend fundamental reproductive rights, and uphold our democracy in the face of unprecedented attacks.
Winning her race won’t be easy. Nevada’s last Senate race was decided by just 7,928 votes – the closest margin of any Senate election in 2022 – and Republicans are targeting her race with millions of dollars worth of attack ads. She will need every dollar she can get to compete and protect her vulnerable seat. [**So I’m asking again: Will you help meet this moment by chipping in $5 to Jacky Rosen’s campaign ahead of her critical end-of-quarter fundraising deadline tomorrow?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93819691/501734849/1399008008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4786-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMTA5ZjMwYi01YjdlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=P4Jn8Y1nIZGDWKjCheEg1JuSl3Hk__il8VgJz-4j164=)

Fellow American, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow American, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-dNViiRoo5mQ)_
---
[**Make your gift & get your FREE book**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._DUtg)

Fellow American, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

**I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE.** _**[All I ask for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-QSQCHA)**_

We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness. We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution. We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal. We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night. We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans. Fellow American, I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before: It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right. It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American. It's NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving ourselves. I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE. In this defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to find all that's possible in the days ahead. Thank YOU for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of Turning Point USA. For America, Charlie Kirk Founder & CEO Turning Point USA 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 Faith & Liberty PO Box 455 Leesburg, VA 20178 If you no longer wish to receive sponsored promotional emails from us to unsubscribe.

A battleground Senate race is no joke, Peter.
Over the next few weeks, thousands of volunteers will reach out to folks across all of Pennsylvania’s 67 counties.
**But here’s the deal: We need to reach _millions of people._** In 2022, more than 5.3 million people cast their ballots in Pennsylvania’s Senate race -- and with Kamala Harris and Donald Trump also on the ticket, we expect even more this year.
All in all, we’re expecting more than $150,000,000 to be spent to defeat Bob in ads on TV, on the radio, and online, and we’re being outspent by hundreds of millions. We’ve got to fight back.
[**If you’re ready to do your part to help re-elect Bob, chip in $5 or any amount today. Our end-of-quarter deadline is in just one day, so time is critical now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240929-2?refcode=em20240929-2&refcode2=4378_552475_icJWSN&akid=4378%2E552475%2EicJWSN)

subject: Mysterious news site boosts down-ballot Dems
body:
News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | |
---
| | | Good morning and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Weekly Reads.

[Subscribe to our daily email list](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ab906f10d2&e=b7b3eddce2) and get the best of _Broad + Liberty_ delivered straight to your inbox.
---
|
---
|
### **1.[Lies about Haitian immigrants do a disservice to them and to America](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=de877d8673&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Christine Flowers_
There was no evidence of Haitians stealing, cooking, and dining on domesticated animals. The story was debunked before it even made national news, and still there were people saying that it could be true. There still are people who argue against all evidence that immigrants are eating pets. And then you have JD Vance, whom I normally like, perpetuating a myth from his home state.

I understand the discomfort that comes from seeing an influx of people who have different traditions, a different language and a completely different history sent to middle America. We saw that problem in Minnesota when a large number of Somali refugees were resettled in an area founded by largely Scandinavian immigrants. The “melting pot” doesn’t work as well when you try and put oil, and then water, into that recipe. In fact, it boils over.

But the way to deal with the very real problems that come from the mixing of cultures and people is not to make up defamatory stories. There are mechanisms by which we can reconcile our differences and become the welcoming society that we’ve always aspired to create.

**Why It Matters**. Choosing to demonize people who don’t look or sound like us based on myths is anti-American, and “anti” everything I was raised to believe in.

And this should not be an issue where conservatives abandon the high moral road to liberals. Conservatives are the true party of acceptance, of empathy, and of dignity. We defend unborn life, and we defend refugees who come here with their family-based values and their desire for freedom and a better life. We have much more in common with immigrants than people who have spent the last half century pandering to them, and forcing them into some unwelcome box of victimization.

[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=0721bb1d62&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
---
|
### **2.[Questionable news site continues promoting down-ballot Democrats using Facebook ads](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=eae772115b&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Todd Shepherd_
_Morning Mirror_ began running the Instagram and Facebook ads for the Democrats on May 23, the day of the Pennsylvania primary, using generic positive messages with uncontroversial, feel-good political positions. For example, a message will say a candidate is “working to lower costs for Pennsylvania families,” or the candidate has a “campaign priority for Pennsylvania: good-paying jobs.”

Yet a check of the _Morning Mirror_ ’s homepage clearly shows the site does not strive to create original news content in any meaningful sense. On [Sept. 12 this year](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7da1429c35&e=b7b3eddce2), the most recent “stories” posted on the site’s homepage all dated back to August, meaning no contemporary content had been created in two weeks. Although fall was beginning, the site’s “lifestyle” section was inviting readers to “Celebrate Spring at the 2024 National Cherry Blossom Festival in Washington, DC.”

**Why It Matters**. In its brief existence of less than eight months, the _Morning Mirror_ has spent over $172,000 on Facebook and Instagram ads spanning Pennsylvania, Florida, Michigan, and Wisconsin, all swing states.
The Pennsylvania Department of State declined to say whether the _Morning Mirror_ ’s activities might violate the commonwealth’s campaign finance laws.

“The Department of State operates on a complaint-driven process. The Department does not offer interpretations of the campaign finance reporting law,” DOS spokeswoman Amy Gulli said.
All of the ads say the _Morning Mirror_ is owned by Star Spangled Media, a business entity registered in New York. Star Spangled Media has not answered requests for comment from several media organizations including Axios, and CJR.

# **4\. What we're reading**
"Consider[ the latest Gallup data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a35ca45fb6&e=b7b3eddce2). Among the ten key indicators ahead of the 2024 presidential election, nine of them—including voters’ views on the economy—show Trump and the Republicans should have the upper hand.” [So writes Oliver Wiseman](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ef9346a181&e=b7b3eddce2) this week at the _Free Press_. In an election environment that massively favors a change in party, why does it feel like Republicans are running in quicksand? It’s a good synopsis of why Trump should be winning, if he could just get out of his own way.**“**

name: Tampa Police - PBA
subject: 11 of our officers lost their homes during Hurricane Helene, and they need your help
body:
Dear Supporters, As you likely know, Hurricane Helene ravaged the coast of Florida on Thursday night.
---
| | | | | |
---
| | | | **11 of our officers lost their homes during Hurricane Helene, and they need your help**
---
| | | Dear Supporters, As you likely know, Hurricane Helene ravaged the coast of Florida on Thursday night. Unfortunately, 11 Tampa Police officers have been displaced from their homes due to 4-feet of flooding. These men and women, most of whom were out protecting Tampa’s residents and putting their lives on the line during the storm, dutifully finished their shifts and came home to find their houses and belongings destroyed. Our dedicated officers serve this community with pride day-in and day-out, and now they need the community’s help in return. [**We are humbly asking that you donate to our relief fund for the 11 officers who have lost it all**. ](https://eaz1p.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBnbZJtmDuJ61hzGx6/rIZcdiNPSOAt) Right now, none of them can live in their homes, and they have to make other arrangements. It will take several months, if not longer, for their homes to be repaired and liveable. [**The Tampa PBA prides itself on helping our officers when they are in need, and that’s why we are asking for your generous support today**.](https://eaz1p.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13FkOH4wNOOvKRxZXM/nYLFOwNpOyWE) **We began asking for the public’s help via our social media only a few hours ago, and more than $1,000 has already been contributed****.** We are so thankful for everyone who has chipped in already, and if you can do the same, we will be enormously grateful for your help. If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=d771348ed4c7479fb7baf525a724cdc6&_e=-DzC8QTQRoQUCza1q66Jex1FHXIVATKuyKNJOgxJnCAEBeUhPlgZrJwyIGl2PX5Luaz0BQ6C3KftdMr6cHEftDsBJhCT4sEK8ypDzD5sJdmzZVVE8tMXSxD2By2IXGeL_0-Y_c23mY6BYNP_Ok2UoBzTko2-lpy4fjF5KwhfKNeud6Q7As4rnz6hvL82U8g5jmYzzaHjxvXLXvk10JbF2SeK_q77XRnRYvMUT7hMXFw%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=d771348ed4c7479fb7baf525a724cdc6&_e=-DzC8QTQRoQUCza1q66Jex1FHXIVATKuyKNJOgxJnCAEBeUhPlgZrJwyIGl2PX5Luaz0BQ6C3KftdMr6cHEftK6niaK1AfzLtDoinejN5yh1PiHsMF_-uuqnLun7p6aOxmWwL-8wJvwA5lB-XV8L2iNAwiKOuxMkiXwUQ5ohEAVAanm9Sc5TM6nw9f5aw2Lus2vP8IDYdjWBwkLeJgcD_JnaY3uVYZYq7vvzaD73Sx4%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. name: Jerry Evans
subject: Tough Financial Decisions
body:
We Can’t Afford More Taxes
| | | |
---
| The issues couldn't be more clear - the constituents in Illinois' 11th Congressional District are worried. Seriously worried about how they are going to pay their bills each month.
Questions are being asked around the kitchen table late at night - "do we pay the car insurance this month or our health insurance premiums?"
"What if our prescription drug copay continues to rise - do we pay for some of the drugs we need and not others?"
"What if heating oil prices continue to rise and how do we pay to heat our home this winter?"
"Should we only go to the grocery store once every three weeks instead of weekly when prices continue to rise on daily essentials like butter, milk & eggs?"
These are all questions that are keeping the voters in our district up at night - both figuratively and literally.
THIS is why I am running for Congress, because I share the same worries. I know every politician says they know what it's like to pay a mortgage and run a business. But I actually do know what it's like to pay the mortgage every month and run a business to support my family. We have the same worries as you, and my opponent, Bill Foster, is now talking about raising taxes! He has had almost 15 years to step up and has done nothing for the 11th Congressional District.
I want to be your Congressman to get things done. I also know that I have the ability to reach across the aisle to work with Republicans and Democrats so that we can make our community a model.
[But you know to get elected I need your support.](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001m1fdu1gEeCGbsaE-Ir5cC8RDKo-XH4vDCn6y3DKJRojsIYJs2pezcYKZdCy5SnNaDYhrThgFcXG-iC_daEUJj07X3zsP95HLjyEBR4I6xxmkzDuuahm9ltK9BEZ24a_rUzH4_1XtbX-PRXNdDbrjOAmOGgaf7rvqGgaeNpEVeORIUliO_DOYbX3AGl8t2LIbOpLCUcNb2UdpJgSlMqzN_tHIEdlFdLX39BeFFD4GRBE=&c=1nBHsWYuXWzhgzk2ztiB9md5T4g9lHiAk4f1gr7fKenwUjiErxRnRA==&ch=9abEp12sibPa2-wLnTZJDRirUSX-WyOLKXBHhwnSr0t8847e5EAF-g==) Many of you have donated to my campaign, knocked doors, made phone calls and have come out to our events, and I thank you. But we have a critical fundraising deadline at midnight on September 30th and I need your help to make sure that all the voters get to see my message of hope and opportunity.
The maximum you can donate to my campaign is $3,300 per person/$6,660 per couple. If you have not maxed out, I would humbly ask for your generous financial support and help us before the September 30th deadline. If you have given, it would mean so much to me to have you match the donation you previously gave to the campaign.
Contributions can be made at [www.jerryevansforcongress.com/donate](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001m1fdu1gEeCGbsaE-Ir5cC8RDKo-XH4vDCn6y3DKJRojsIYJs2pezcYKZdCy5SnNaDYhrThgFcXG-iC_daEUJj07X3zsP95HLjyEBR4I6xxmkzDuuahm9ltK9BEZ24a_rUzH4_1XtbX-PRXNdDbrjOAmOGgaf7rvqGgaeNpEVeORIUliO_DOYbX3AGl8t2LIbOpLCUcNb2UdpJgSlMqzN_tHIEdlFdLX39BeFFD4GRBE=&c=1nBHsWYuXWzhgzk2ztiB9md5T4g9lHiAk4f1gr7fKenwUjiErxRnRA==&ch=9abEp12sibPa2-wLnTZJDRirUSX-WyOLKXBHhwnSr0t8847e5EAF-g==). It will take you right to the donation page.
I know I can win. And when I do win, I will work every day for YOU.
I thank you in advance for your consideration and your help.
Sincerely,
Jerry Evans
P.S. One last thing -it would be so helpful if you would be willing to forward this email to 3 friends so that they can help too. Thank You!

Then we have out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley, who have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.

body:
It’s important.

| Hey there, folks, Willie Nelson and Margo Price here. We recently teamed up to talk about something mighty important — November’s right around the corner, and what we do with our votes could make a big difference, especially down in Tennessee and Texas. We know we’re all talking about the presidential race right now, and that’s important. But we want to shine a light on two other races that hit closer to home. **This November, we’ve got a real shot to elect Gloria Johnson and Colin Allred to the U.S. Senate.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93839925/501789935/-1457683982?refcode=ea.b2b6b331-6d7e-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.b2b6b331-6d7e-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmI2YjMzMS02ZDdlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1PkJoF6s1FiXGVR4awZLQ6lo3cvp2rjhYlEV2Q4sOlk=) There are 33 Senate seats up for grabs in November. One of them could go to Gloria — a leader who isn’t afraid to fight for _all_ Tennesseans, no matter their race, who they worship, or who they love. She’s got the grit to take on the big fights, whether it’s protecting LGBTQ+ rights or looking out for working families. Tennessee needs someone like her — someone who’s in tune with what real people are going through. Another one of those seats could go to Colin Allred — he’s a 4th generation Texan who was raised by a single mom in Dallas. After playing in the NFL and serving as a civil rights attorney, Colin was elected to the House of Representatives, where he fights to protect the fundamental values of our democracy. Texas has had too many years of Ted Cruz just looking out for himself — it’s time to get someone in the Senate who will look out for all Texans, and that’s Colin. But here’s the deal, friend: None of this happens if folks don’t vote. When I got the news of Senator Menendez's indictment, I was with my boys at a doctor's appointment. I didn't know how to feel. I hit a breaking point. We live in a time of the greatest amount of distrust in government. It can't go on like this.**So 24 hours later, I decided to run for Senate.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93841585/501793772/-1197072038?refcode=2024-09-29-eoq&recurring=&amount=10&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=ba284cbb-6e7e-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYTI4NGNiYi02ZTdlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LlCBBeGynmZSkZiK0Xm8xPpDXtDnc-3yZjhcR2iIBaA=)
After the indictment news broke, I ran into a neighbor and asked him, "What do you think of the indictment of Senator Menendez?" He responded, "That's Jersey." 84% of people in New Jersey believe their politicians are corrupt. How does democracy function with that level of distrust?
**I've been saying this line a lot lately, "I believe the opposite of democracy is apathy."** Our democracy is in danger when we don't feel empowered to shape and change it. When we feel helpless and powerless.
I felt strongly that to fight against cynicism and to heal our democracy, the people of New Jersey needed a choice on their ballot for Senate. But the question before me was, "What is my role in this?"
My kids were 6 and 7 years old. I was more secure in my Congressional seat after several tough elections. If I ran for Senate, I couldn't run for re-election in the House. _Do I risk it all?_
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93841586/501793773/-1197072038?refcode=2024-09-29-eoq&recurring=&amount=10&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=ba284cbb-6e7e-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYTI4NGNiYi02ZTdlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LlCBBeGynmZSkZiK0Xm8xPpDXtDnc-3yZjhcR2iIBaA=)
I didn't get a second of sleep that night. The next morning, I pulled together a conference call of my senior staff and past campaign managers. I asked them if I should consider running. All of them said I should consider it. One said we should look at launching in maybe 6 weeks.
I asked back, "What would you say if I wanted to launch 3 hours from now?" The Senator's indictment was all over the news, and our state had been plunged into a crisis point over what comes next. **I thought the moment demanded clarity.**
I talked to my wife, and we made the decision together to run for Senate. We made that decision because we are parents really terrified about what kind of America our kids are going to grow up in. We want to do everything we can to heal our country.
**This last year has been the craziest of my life, but I'm proud of what we've accomplished.** Not only did we win the primary, but we also changed Jersey politics forever along the way. And we showed what we can accomplish when we fight against apathy.

clean_body: I’ve been saying this line a lot lately, “I believe the opposite of democracy is apathy.” | | | | = Donate Now If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = ---|--- = | = = When I got the news of Senator Menendez's indictment, I was with my boys at a doctor's appointment. I didn't know how to feel. I hit a breaking point. We live in a time of the greatest amount of distrust in government. It can't go on like this.So 24 hours later, I decided to run for Senate. = After the indictment news broke, I ran into a neighbor and asked him, "What do you think of the indictment of Senator Menendez?" He responded, "That's Jersey." 84% of people in New Jersey believe their politicians are corrupt. How does democracy function with that level of distrust? I've been saying this line a lot lately, "I believe the opposite of democracy is apathy." Our democracy is in danger when we don't feel empowered to shape and change it. When we feel helpless and powerless. I felt strongly that to fight against cynicism and to heal our democracy, the people of New Jersey needed a choice on their ballot for Senate. But the question before me was, "What is my role in this?" My kids were 6 and 7 years old. I was more secure in my Congressional seat after several tough elections. If I ran for Senate, I couldn't run for re-election in the House. Do I risk it all? = I didn't get a second of sleep that night. The next morning, I pulled together a conference call of my senior staff and past campaign managers. I asked them if I should consider running. All of them said I should consider it. One said we should look at launching in maybe 6 weeks. I asked back, "What would you say if I wanted to launch 3 hours from now?" The Senator's indictment was all over the news, and our state had been plunged into a crisis point over what comes next. I thought the moment demanded clarity. I talked to my wife, and we made the decision together to run for Senate. We made that decision because we are parents really terrified about what kind of America our kids are going to grow up in. We want to do everything we can to heal our country. This last year has been the craziest of my life, but I'm proud of what we've accomplished. Not only did we win the primary, but we also changed Jersey politics forever along the way. #
---
| It’s National Coffee Day!
That means that it’s a day to go out, snag a cup of your favorite coffee, and unwind! What if you had a chance to take the money you’d spend on that cup though, and put it toward a good cause?
[**What if that cause was Montana’s future?**](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=70f3c43d91&e=9ec0a0596f)
---
[](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=63781f3089&e=9ec0a0596f)
| **As Chair of Montana’s Public Service Commission my opponent stuck Montanans with a whopping 24% increase in their electric rates (25% increase to small businesses) and staffed the agency with his cronies – and as a lawyer, he worked for and defended dark money organizations. And since elected to the PSC 4 yrs ago, he has spent a majority of his time running for other offices! Now he wants to get into your insurance matters and stop fraud??? **
I’m running to see that doesn’t happen. I am the ONLY candidate for State Auditor with the independence, political will and commitment to stand up for everyday folks and small businesses in Montana. Folks who need a strong voice representing them against the out of state corporate and lobbying interests that currently have the upper hand. Everyday folks who are being squeezed out by high home prices, spikes in utility bills, untenable medical bills, rapidly rising property taxes, and ... yes ... increases in insurance premiums.
---
[ACT NOW](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=407fb4267c&e=9ec0a0596f)
| We deserve better.
[**With just $6, the cost of a cup of coffee, you can help me be the State Auditor that we all deserve. We have a real chance of winning, and every dollar you donate helps me get just a little closer.**](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=408759fa5d&e=9ec0a0596f)
**Best,**

Today I want to tell you about how homophobia nearly destroyed my life.

As many of you know, I was publicly outed by my Republican opponent in the 90s.

But before that, in the 70’s, **Proposition 6 nearly ended my career before it began.**

**Proposition 6** was a ballot initiative that would have banned gays and lesbians from teaching in public college.

Similar initiatives passed in other states and right-wing activists were determined to pass it in California.

_If it had passed, my 20+ year career in public teaching would never have been possible._ And without that, I would never have been inspired to run for Congress.

So as you can see,**right-wing hatred of the LGBTQ+ community has real, tangible effects on the lives of everyday LGBTQ+ people.** And I’ve seen that firsthand my entire life.

That’s why I’m fighting so hard to be an advocate for LGBTQ+ folks and other minorities. And It’s why I’m fighting to flip the House blue so we can pass strong protections for vulnerable communities.

But Peter, I can’t do this without you. **I have a major End of Quarter fundraising deadline on Tuesday and I still need to raise $5,000 to have the funds we need to succeed.**

clean_body: Proposition 6 | = Today I want to tell you about how homophobia nearly destroyed my life. As many of you know, I was publicly outed by my Republican opponent in the 90s. But before that, in the 70’s, Proposition 6 nearly ended my career before it began. Proposition 6 was a ballot initiative that would have banned gays and lesbians from teaching in public college. Similar initiatives passed in other states and right-wing activists were determined to pass it in California. If it had passed, my 20+ year career in public teaching would never have been possible. And without that, I would never have been inspired to run for Congress. So as you can see,right-wing hatred of the LGBTQ+ community has real, tangible effects on the lives of everyday LGBTQ+ people. And I’ve seen that firsthand my entire life. That’s why I’m fighting so hard to be an advocate for LGBTQ+ folks and other minorities. Team,
There's no way to sugarcoat this: A major party is advocating for a constitutional change in Texas that would codify their power and control into the state constitution . From the Austin American-Statesman:
" The Texas Republican Party platform now calls for a state constitutional amendment to create another requirement for winning statewide office: In addition to winning the most votes statewide, a candidate would have to win a majority of the votes in a majority of Texas’ 254 counties. "
This would create a mini-Electoral College just within Texas itself, with one vote for each county. Harris County, home to Houston and nearly 5 million people, would count exactly the same as Loving County, whose population during the 2020 census was recorded as 64 people .
For example, Texas' current governor won reelection with only 55% of the popular vote but "won" 235 counties. This constitutional amendment, if passed, would guarantee no other party could win a statewide election without taking away all those rural, deeply conservative counties. Opponents of voting rights want to use land, not people, to keep themselves in power permanently.
They're openly advocating for anti-democratic rules to limit the impact of people's votes just because they want to stay in control, Team. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: would you take a moment to meet Jackson?
body:
Dear Peter,

The Abortion Lobby is throwing everything it’s got into this upcoming election in November.

They’ve got millions of taxpayer dollars to cushion their efforts . . .

They have the media, academia, Big Tech, Hollywood, and many in the corporate world on their side.

So, you and I are no match for them . . . right?

Of course, that’s what the Abortion Lobby wants us to believe. But they couldn’t be more wrong.

You see, you and I have the TRUTH on our side.

And thousands of passionate young people just like Jackson Lewis who dedicate their time to defend preborn lives!

So, will you please agree to help keep Jackson and our other canvassers knocking on doors in key Battleground and Referendum States through Election Day
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/7dHj3qCpPzNvTgDP6svhqw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L--WZDKkpXUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
?

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/M0UuaA7mN5Kyjuconzo_lw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L--WZDKkpXUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~

The great news is, with our End of Quarter $125,000 Matching Challenge, every dollar you can give will be DOUBLED
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/IOVO1kHlqPE0n6lUg3_GZg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L--WZDKkpXUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
!

Your support would be such a huge help!

Like so many of our canvassers, Jackson is new to door-knocking (his first time was just this spring!).

But he never let nerves get in the way – even though it can be quite nerve-racking for young people to knock on the doors of strangers and then just start talking about abortion!

Jackson’s deep faith and strong conviction that all Life matters are what drives him.

As a Senior at Middle Tennessee State University, Jackson spends much of his free time volunteering at a local Pregnancy Help Center.

Now, Jackson is pounding the pavement to educate voters about the high stakes for mothers and preborn babies this fall.

So, please consider agreeing to your most generous dollar-for-dollar matched contribution to help support students like Jackson through our End of Quarter $125,000 Matching Challenge
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/LSEiqEsYyLAGsxLYI6Tn7g~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L--WZDKkpXUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
!

As you and I know, standing for what’s right isn’t easy.

And it can feel lonely for some of our students when they’re out having hard conversations with voters about abortion.

But one thing Jackson told us stands out to me:

“Seeing a sea of thousands of other pro-lifers [at the March for Life in Washington, D.C.] standing with me in the crowd really invigorated my passion for defending Life and assured me that there are a lot more of us than the mainstream culture had led me to believe.”

You see, the Abortion Goliath has its claws so deep in America that it makes some people think that they are alone when they stand for Life.

But they’re not.

The Pro-Life Movement is massive – and it’s growing, thanks to the support of good folks like you.

Your contribution – which will be doubled through September 30th – will help keep canvassers on the ground, knocking on doors through Election Day
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/qdQpd5dH44HWTwAZGDRgpQ~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L--WZDKkpXUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
.

Your support will make a tremendous difference across all 10 Battleground and Ballot Referendum States we’re targeting, including:

>>> ARIZONA AND FLORIDA, our top two targets, as both states are Presidential Battlegrounds, U.S. Senate Battlegrounds, have abortion referendums on the ballot, and critical state legislative races we’re working on;

>>> GEORGIA, MICHIGAN, NORTH CAROLINA, AND PENNSYLVANIA, which are Presidential Battlegrounds, have key state legislative races, and Michigan and Pennsylvania both have U.S. Senate contests as well; and

>>> MISSOURI, MONTANA, NEBRASKA, AND SOUTH DAKOTA, which all have hotly-contested, pro-abortion ballot referendum battles.

So, please agree to your most generous contribution of:

>>
$1,000 (which instantly doubles to $2,000!)
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/tTiXStXs5f-dJcDKNTt3tA~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L-P4Q_~

>>
$500 (which instantly doubles to $1,000!)
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Uuw3sAtAzOg_2xUF86dThw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L-

>>
$250 (which instantly doubles to $500!)
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Xzd-_cq2fKZKirw2HB0aFA~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L-

>>
$100 (which instantly doubles to $200!)
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/V0aMjk40DsY4yTB9xbLZCg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L-

>>
$50 (which instantly doubles to $100!)
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/2jUV21tCDdxJdKBTpHy_Qw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L-~

Even a gift of just $25 (which instantly doubles to $50) would be a huge help
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/xD5MH7cLSmQTMkaef8V5KA~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L-~
!

Every single penny counts in this critical fight.

And I’m just grateful for good folks like you and Jackson who do what they can for Life.

So, thank you for all you do!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – I really feel like the Pro-Life Movement is gaining A LOT of momentum right now.

But I’m worried we won’t be able to keep it up if we can’t keep our canvassers knocking on doors through Election Day.

So, can I count on you for your most generous contribution of $50, $100, $250, or even $500 — which will be doubled — by September 30th to help keep our canvassers knocking on doors through Election Day
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/KsuvNszGSPTWSQ9X9I3pew~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo2_L--WZDKkpXUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~

Peter,

With time running out before my final FEC end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day, I'm asking you to take three minutes to read my message below.

_**I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end.**_

Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=9fc66bd79313419880c32f99d44dd892&_e=0GE_JydeDh72WVDbKJwxk0EBIDkhJedPcw-1BR5f40UA64I_uioKBL4x176sf3n2CKDEQXC_oHjDdbI5LaFK7NCFTWMWCYEa3Q46OoUIJsPZxEISdA6cbt9cNvkdm-UXzk_ez2ITtgnAdv_UZbZYJ0XBl5Yy_VsoiqxWrtevLQuWtJu0FVoAxDvhS9bQp6Hfdny9CXLspe75v5BKHv8rJo3kEuRYK06kGgDkJA-k0QJq-KWUhvEVvPVmMd2OvEqCMQJwwSnW-ht89Bwzks2FnQAcd9iLCVNJAn3bvzYyC_YMf7SwCLtAPmtx-gm1JKPUFmIgMWyhcaWUeoBX4F2k3C8-9MccQOtAwQu17stbCZGH9LCAn0b68IkpcXYCba_0)

My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=9fc66bd79313419880c32f99d44dd892&_e=0GE_JydeDh72WVDbKJwxk0EBIDkhJedPcw-1BR5f40UA64I_uioKBL4x176sf3n2CKDEQXC_oHjDdbI5LaFK7NCFTWMWCYEa3Q46OoUIJsPZxEISdA6cbt9cNvkdm-UXzk_ez2ITtgnAdv_UZbZYJ0XBl5Yy_VsoiqxWrtevLQuWtJu0FVoAxDvhS9bQp6Hfdny9CXLspe75v5BKHv8rJo3kEuRYK06kGgDkJA-k0QIH3qwTp3OhYMqBkRRmZA-Zt-ccfBeIH4rI1Z9UVN8N1osm9R3LXjl9RwFCIUl4YnrQYYs_7lQfFMzAC6WdyVjcgKupII5mHbXkl-znlnaVoYlksOj_ypv3a1aP3hfpyw2x5zTZ9xs2aY5Nby_pjQ_3)

I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=9fc66bd79313419880c32f99d44dd892&_e=0GE_JydeDh72WVDbKJwxk0EBIDkhJedPcw-1BR5f40UA64I_uioKBL4x176sf3n2CKDEQXC_oHjDdbI5LaFK7NCFTWMWCYEa3Q46OoUIJsPZxEISdA6cbt9cNvkdm-UXzk_ez2ITtgnAdv_UZbZYJ0XBl5Yy_VsoiqxWrtevLQuWtJu0FVoAxDvhS9bQp6Hfdny9CXLspe75v5BKHv8rJo3kEuRYK06kGgDkJA-k0QLzaXQYHxHwQvTzpuMtjNAA2Xf91O6AbNReSRPUqRPiLQZhQqdtar00A0Gm11z_NCW7DqdemIXvYIkXKR3zVYsUs0CWRWpy_-JCQSw7Vu-xPbtqbvBP2CZRF_y6xy_Oxqtt5Zh_160rsEGtyQg95H55)

I’m so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=9fc66bd79313419880c32f99d44dd892&_e=0GE_JydeDh72WVDbKJwxk0EBIDkhJedPcw-1BR5f40UA64I_uioKBL4x176sf3n2CKDEQXC_oHjDdbI5LaFK7NCFTWMWCYEa3Q46OoUIJsPZxEISdA6cbt9cNvkdm-UXzk_ez2ITtgnAdv_UZbZYJ0XBl5Yy_VsoiqxWrtevLQuWtJu0FVoAxDvhS9bQp6Hfdny9CXLspe75v5BKHv8rJo3kEuRYK06kGgDkJA-k0QKoUP3Xx2dDfq3CjS2waslB90N-t4M0hiHdvLeHJVJlO5cP42TI_ER_ZoQcqiXSXwRLgWhHcWVUfrpqaPUrgIJJHkG48wEajrUVmvLnIdWLMdkMjQdGeecfjvvq8DS65g_MFM6lReob04NmLnTwEq3l)

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=9fc66bd79313419880c32f99d44dd892&_e=0GE_JydeDh72WVDbKJwxk0EBIDkhJedPcw-1BR5f40UA64I_uioKBL4x176sf3n2CKDEQXC_oHjDdbI5LaFK7NCFTWMWCYEa3Q46OoUIJsPZxEISdA6cbt9cNvkdm-UXzk_ez2ITtgnAdv_UZbZYJ0XBl5Yy_VsoiqxWrtevLQuWtJu0FVoAxDvhS9bQp6Hfdny9CXLspe75v5BKHv8rJo3kEuRYK06kGgDkJA-k0QKJISCS1bcDcd6rMrVXDHq7JpnTH1vI9-uPR5Tc1VmzMkHZvPBwQrLodLK373zLgWdbCQE9VOeAwWa_w05SLyy5ufWdsiLk1n-jik-_f3s_nEKMmY-x6mDOUzuZdxLxR2mvx32uoudnYy07oAy0wd8P)

And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=9fc66bd79313419880c32f99d44dd892&_e=0GE_JydeDh72WVDbKJwxk0EBIDkhJedPcw-1BR5f40UA64I_uioKBL4x176sf3n2CKDEQXC_oHjDdbI5LaFK7NCFTWMWCYEa3Q46OoUIJsPZxEISdA6cbt9cNvkdm-UXzk_ez2ITtgnAdv_UZbZYJ0XBl5Yy_VsoiqxWrtevLQuWtJu0FVoAxDvhS9bQp6Hfdny9CXLspe75v5BKHv8rJo3kEuRYK06kGgDkJA-k0QJ196qVA4MI9Zi287hSpcDmwk7zcpnSpqSUCJ4V8MMq9iw3b8SaWf_bQ1fHUITOocvJ_5dDc7_3gdxhBRRCdgS6oTcMzqzIi4AeaRgUYRG_nTZkW7tva2ifwGHS2gXkK96oURtlqh7Ie_th7ts3dRTY)

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=9fc66bd79313419880c32f99d44dd892&_e=0GE_JydeDh72WVDbKJwxk0EBIDkhJedPcw-1BR5f40UA64I_uioKBL4x176sf3n2CKDEQXC_oHjDdbI5LaFK7NCFTWMWCYEa3Q46OoUIJsPZxEISdA6cbt9cNvkdm-UXzk_ez2ITtgnAdv_UZbZYJ0XBl5Yy_VsoiqxWrtevLQuWtJu0FVoAxDvhS9bQp6Hfdny9CXLspe75v5BKHv8rJo3kEuRYK06kGgDkJA-k0QIK-RIf5yiZE2aPO4JNpvpBquGiHV6vxbgf0NZnE6vy8ZU8DzcHISS9RJPxeXSTDQS-0Cexi6hfV9UiMWsTcCyK-JLqRClbjKdRtwmuQzVX6Is_1XEuKzKgAfmDc8I7y3D3NNI9j46nykhaKhrARXIZ)

**The small rural town of Bloomsburg shaped who I am. I'm proud to be a 7th -generation Pennsylvanian and I'm ready to get to work to help the great people of our state.**

All this is to say, I've lived the American Dream, and I am so grateful for the opportunities that America and Pennsylvania have afforded me.

_**BUT, I am worried that the American Dream is slipping away.**_**Career politicians like my opponent Bob Casey and Kamala Harris are doing NOTHING to stop inflation, allowing rampant crime to go unchecked, and allowing dangerous drugs to cross our borders in excess.** Their policies have made America weaker, and I can’t sit back and let that happen. I'm running for U.S. Senate to shake up the status quo.

I know we've only got a little bit of time left until Election Day, and the latest poll has Bob Casey and me in a dead heat. _That's why every dollar during this final stretch is so important._ We have a chance to send a leader to Washington who will look out for the great people of our state and put Pennsylvanians first.

But in order to win this race, I am going to need your help to get it done.

**[So can I count on you to chip in before my FEC deadline?](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=9fc66bd79313419880c32f99d44dd892&_e=0GE_JydeDh72WVDbKJwxk0EBIDkhJedPcw-1BR5f40UA64I_uioKBL4x176sf3n2CKDEQXC_oHjDdbI5LaFK7NCFTWMWCYEa3Q46OoUIJsPZxEISdA6cbt9cNvkdm-UXzk_ez2ITtgnAdv_UZbZYJ0XBl5Yy_VsoiqxWrtevLQuWtJu0FVoAxDvhS9bQp6Hfdny9CXLspe75v5BKHv8rJo3kEuRYK06kGgDkJA-k0QLkA573EMy-9A5wWyB4J_2aRS--2hUrKcrBZMtWUl_VV6qCJ3KLHzG1WIiXhmnlTb3hRuntyh-yqNZ8OFKZRos2X20UT3fkV4LwM4wckPET1JKk3Ol27O_hlsLUFdRy-y3Ij8QZcE-_fhM2-HZ4SLWM)**

clean_body: Peter, With time running out before my final FEC end-of-quarter deadline before Election Day, I'm asking you to take three minutes to read my message below. I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end. Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old. I’m so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg. It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War. The small rural town of Bloomsburg shaped who I am. I'm proud to be a 7th -generation Pennsylvanian and I'm ready to get to work to help the great people of our state. All this is to say, I've lived the American Dream, and I am so grateful for the opportunities that America and Pennsylvania have afforded me. BUT, I am worried that the American Dream is slipping away.Career politicians like my opponent Bob Casey and Kamala Harris are doing NOTHING to stop inflation, allowing rampant crime to go unchecked, and allowing dangerous drugs to cross our borders in excess. Their policies have made America weaker, and I can’t sit back and let that happen. I'm running for U.S. Senate to shake up the status quo. I know we've only got a little bit of time left until Election Day, and the latest poll has Bob Casey and me in a dead heat. That's why every dollar during this final stretch is so important. We have a chance to send a leader to Washington who will look out for the great people of our state and put Pennsylvanians first. But in order to win this race, I am going to need your help to get it done. Thank you for all of your support. Thank you, Dave McCormick Paid for by Friends of Dave McCormick. Our mailing address is: PO BOX 23537 PITTSBURGH, PA 15222

body:
#

Team -
In just 37 days from today, it will be Election Day. But right now, thousands of people across the nation are already casting their ballots through early voting.
Our gun safety majority in the Senate hangs on by a thread. We currently have a House of Representatives led by a Speaker who refuses to bring any gun safety legislation to the floor for a vote. The race between Vice President Kamala Harris and Donald Trump is neck-and-neck.
If we were to slow down in our work to take back the House, maintain our Senate majority, and elect Vice President Harris, the results we wake up to on November 6th could be catastrophic for our movement for gun safety.
We’re sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.
We’re so proud to have endorsed 183 candidates so far this cycle, including gun safety champions running for state legislatures, US Senate, and the US House. body:
In Iraq, I had my Marines. In this campaign, I have you. I’ll fight it out on my own if I have to, but I’m not afraid to ask for help when I need it.
#

Peter - Ruben. Personal note from me today, before tomorrow’s deadline.
It’s hard to shake the feeling that something’s wrong.
I’m not sure what it is, but you can always tell when something bad’s going to happen. I’ve got to tell you — right now, it feels like something’s off. I keep hearing about how this Senate race is locked up, that Kari Lake’s as good as defeated. I’m not seeing that.
You can’t escape the attack ads out here. Every time you turn on the TV they’re on. Trump’s got his eyes firmly fixed on Arizona, and Elon Musk is spending millions of his own money on get-out-the-vote efforts here. Kari Lake is still a threat, and don’t forget — she only lost by a few thousand votes last time.
And at the same time, our own fundraising... it’s not good, Peter. Without giving too much away here, we’re looking at big cuts because we’re not pulling in as much as we hoped we would. All of that adds up.
Marines have an old motto: “First to Fight.” In Iraq, we’d use special knocks to identify friend from foe when we were surrounded by insurgents. The comfort was knowing your friends were with you, that you had each other’s back.
