body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

First, Rep. Rashida Tlaib was the target of a racist, Islamophobic
political cartoon in the far-right outlet, the National Review.

Next, major media outlets including CNN and the head of the
Anti-Defamation League promoted a harmful and fabricated lie about the
Congressmember, misquoting and misrepresenting her remarks about the
Michigan Attorney General issuing unjust criminal charges against student
protesters.

Then, Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel, CNN journalists Dana Bash and
Jake Tapper, and others continued to push dangerous lies about Rashida
despite being fact-checked by the Detroit Metro Times and the reporter of
the original article they’re referring to.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240929-rt.Dq6lF6&refcode=em20240929-36032&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=36032%2E1203867%2EfcJYgq ]Tweet from Steve Neavling: I’m the reporter who interviewed Rashida
Tlaib. She never said Nessel did this because she’s Jewish. Never. You’re
spreading lies.

Despite the correction, CNN reporters refuse to apologize to Rashida and
AG Nessell doubled down on her attacks despite no evidence, perpetuating
Rashida’s actual point: there is a clear anti-Palestinian attitude among
many institutions, including Congress and the media, that has become far
too normalized.

This is what a smear campaign looks like,
Peter. CNN should be ashamed for allowing its
journalists to spread blatant lies about Rashida with impunity, but
instead, it has prioritized attacking the only Palestinian American
Congresswoman over reporting the truth.

Rashida has and will always speak up for the human rights of ALL people
despite these vicious attacks against her character, and Justice Democrats
has her back.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240929-rt.Dq6lF6&refcode=em20240929-36032&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=36032%2E1203867%2EfcJYgq ]Will you split a grassroots donation between us and Rashida’s campaign

We will not sit idly by while members of the press and others in power
spread lies and misinformation about Rashida, a true champion for equality
and peace.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

In communities across the nation, the dream of affordable housing is slipping through the fingers of many, especially impacting vulnerable groups such as the disability community.

It’s because private equity firms are snatching up thousands of entry level homes, leaving home buyers with few options and then renting them out at super inflated prices. It’s making housing unaffordable!
This is hurting folks in the disability community who already face heightened challenges in securing safe, accessible, and affordable housing due to fixed or limited incomes and additional living expenses.
**It’s time to stand against Wall Street's harmful influence on housing costs! Democrats have introduced the Stop Predatory Investing Act to restrict tax breaks for investors who hoard properties, making home ownership more accessible.**
******[Join us and sign on to demand the Senate ensure that our housing market serves the needs of the people, not the pockets of Wall Street. This pivotal legislation, supported by VP Kamala Harris and co-sponsored by Sen. Sherrod Brown, aims to curb the aggressive acquisition of homes by Wall Street private equity firms, which monopolize the housing market, escalate prices, and displace families.

The Stop Predatory Investing Act would level the playing field for first-time homebuyers, promote community-centered housing, and encourage investors to sell properties back to homeowners or nonprofits, prioritizing homes as places to live rather than profit generators.

**The disability community, which often struggles disproportionately with housing instability, needs affordable housing. It is not just a basic need but a right that ensures dignity and quality of life.**

It’s because private equity firms are snatching up thousands of entry level homes, leaving home buyers with few options and then renting them out at super inflated prices. It’s making housing unaffordable! This is hurting folks in the disability community who already face heightened challenges in securing safe, accessible, and affordable housing due to fixed or limited incomes and additional living expenses. It’s time to stand against Wall Street's harmful influence on housing costs! Democrats have introduced the Stop Predatory Investing Act to restrict tax breaks for investors who hoard properties, making home ownership more accessible. ** | This pivotal legislation, supported by VP Kamala Harris and co-sponsored by Sen. Sherrod Brown, aims to curb the aggressive acquisition of homes by Wall Street private equity firms, which monopolize the housing market, escalate prices, and displace families. The Stop Predatory Investing Act would level the playing field for first-time homebuyers, promote community-centered housing, and encourage investors to sell properties back to homeowners or nonprofits, prioritizing homes as places to live rather than profit generators. The disability community, which often struggles disproportionately with housing instability, needs affordable housing. It is not just a basic need but a right that ensures dignity and quality of life. **** ****Together, we can protect our communities and support a future where everyone has access to affordable, suitable housing. Able Dems elects Democrats with disabilities. We fight to protect accessible voting, expand health care and Social Security, and equality for all. Friend, I’m usually not one to get overly emotional, but thinking back to the day I met my husband brings back so many emotions. By now, you’ve probably heard of my husband Sam Brown’s incredible story. I first met Sam in the burn unit. He’d just returned from Afghanistan where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban.

A roadside bomb exploded under his vehicle and left him permanently disfigured. _**[_**Today, I stand by his side as he runs for the U.S. Senate in the biggest race on the map - the race that could ultimately determine the Senate majority.**_](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=378561c5fa8a49dcb7cabf8f4b4bfc6d&_e=MUzVNFKY9O7vqEtp13E0depl6NLLrqxXDo50y6M_ZtWy1IvZLd8rf8b04GJlM_MNTk7LMF99BHJvRFrGrhfuuNSR0uoyuvjDP7E78iQLq2C6m-ycKPbO0Ef5f5ZX4f8m5E68DGz7eUYpsD88jVDKpJMFcf2a5jO6ZvrGHKQ_IlrPVg3J2AXbj0j17Oyz7dFcgSZUs7N46bOPsQfouxUWLwwK9LP3J9vKWcX3eF7IOjCP83q61wNoH6u_j43kUgrZ6C2yFN6gXdg_kOyYKVpZgfzSewxTWTN3HUqeaV06JdYfJhmcEEkpJ9vTJd2LfLSiYj948iq2_TxFm2FxXk49mNqaylTy7Z28gmMIBucD5IOB_xr-0I9x-caZqcPIJqpLMJjNFQ03brV3KFIatV9oja0ryW9Mo9C69I0IZ-oD4Gp5eCy7KCZE5yxPXwEmH34koUX58oBX7fu9OZFkJH218w%3D%3D)**_
---
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=378561c5fa8a49dcb7cabf8f4b4bfc6d&_e=MUzVNFKY9O7vqEtp13E0depl6NLLrqxXDo50y6M_ZtWy1IvZLd8rf8b04GJlM_MNTk7LMF99BHJvRFrGrhfuuNSR0uoyuvjDP7E78iQLq2C6m-ycKPbO0Ef5f5ZX4f8m5E68DGz7eUYpsD88jVDKpJMFcf2a5jO6ZvrGHKQ_IlrPVg3J2AXbj0j17Oyz7dFcgSZUs7N46bOPsQfouxUWLwwK9LP3J9vKWcX3eF7IOjCP83q61wNoH6u_j43kUgrZ6C2yFN6gXdg_kOyYKVpZgfzSewxTWTN3HUqeaV06JdYfJhmcEEkpJ9vTJd2LfLSi4x30ebX2z3AXDfYUCutTZfUV3X4kmAdiBWuPTtzZ4HkXX2N2Fm2C-OZ7KDf6aHBKRsB_jqQy2UZjm2DlJl2mEnmk8PFU8Yk0oodsi9wpDHq0qksKYhUdK0YpFlaxpyXxoO3cszpccy8UvPEATQXMZw%3D%3D)

But what you may not know is that Sam completely turned MY life around. You see, the week leading up to meeting Sam was filled with some of my darkest days. But the day I met Sam in the burn unit was the greatest day of my life. **[**My husband inspired me to return to my Faith in God.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=378561c5fa8a49dcb7cabf8f4b4bfc6d&_e=MUzVNFKY9O7vqEtp13E0depl6NLLrqxXDo50y6M_ZtWy1IvZLd8rf8b04GJlM_MNTk7LMF99BHJvRFrGrhfuuNSR0uoyuvjDP7E78iQLq2C6m-ycKPbO0Ef5f5ZX4f8m5E68DGz7eUYpsD88jVDKpJMFcf2a5jO6ZvrGHKQ_IlrPVg3J2AXbj0j17Oyz7dFcgSZUs7N46bOPsQfouxUWLwwK9LP3J9vKWcX3eF7IOjCP83q61wNoH6u_j43kUgrZ6C2yFN6gXdg_kOyYKVpZgfzSewxTWTN3HUqeaV06JdYfJhmcEEkpJ9vTJd2LfLSiqAfJMNsA99-OmmuJwxuNb_Ne0M7BFVynlIjiJv4aOYqglq2IG5JLrzqQN7XLhCtGi5uBvj1G0SW7WfsBcvvVdloZPTSbjg66AYOujpAEugeKkSr7Yrc3NPtOf2icLDOAnOo05fG36BeDddRuBLHJLA%3D%3D)** Throughout his lengthy recovery - he NEVER gave up hope. But what set Sam apart was that, even when things were at their darkest, **[**his Faith in God was stronger than ever.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=378561c5fa8a49dcb7cabf8f4b4bfc6d&_e=MUzVNFKY9O7vqEtp13E0depl6NLLrqxXDo50y6M_ZtWy1IvZLd8rf8b04GJlM_MNTk7LMF99BHJvRFrGrhfuuNSR0uoyuvjDP7E78iQLq2C6m-ycKPbO0Ef5f5ZX4f8m5E68DGz7eUYpsD88jVDKpJMFcf2a5jO6ZvrGHKQ_IlrPVg3J2AXbj0j17Oyz7dFcgSZUs7N46bOPsQfouxUWLwwK9LP3J9vKWcX3eF7IOjCP83q61wNoH6u_j43kUgrZ6C2yFN6gXdg_kOyYKVpZgfzSewxTWTN3HUqeaV06JdYfJhmcEEkpJ9vTJd2LfLSit51o8VJB2F43wLaBBqMtXAMEFyW7WCx1YH4WQOgw2zBsCQCxPqaslg1KaDHjY4Kz5YALPXAWdDZFJMNnbRov7KUvq_RqXx4L6yV1aq_DzzBoEWV_6wccpJJJ1M_utWxnlGifVq6UUrI8jClh2XfxxA%3D%3D)** Truly, in the darkest days of his recovery, he was a light to everyone around him. Every day for months, he fought with every fiber of his being to recover so he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan. **[That’s why I know Sam will never stop fighting when it matters most for our country.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=378561c5fa8a49dcb7cabf8f4b4bfc6d&_e=MUzVNFKY9O7vqEtp13E0depl6NLLrqxXDo50y6M_ZtWy1IvZLd8rf8b04GJlM_MNTk7LMF99BHJvRFrGrhfuuNSR0uoyuvjDP7E78iQLq2C6m-ycKPbO0Ef5f5ZX4f8m5E68DGz7eUYpsD88jVDKpJMFcf2a5jO6ZvrGHKQ_IlrPVg3J2AXbj0j17Oyz7dFcgSZUs7N46bOPsQfouxUWLwwK9LP3J9vKWcX3eF7IOjCP83q61wNoH6u_j43kUgrZ6C2yFN6gXdg_kOyYKVpZgfzSewxTWTN3HUqeaV06JdYfJhmcEEkpJ9vTJd2LfLSiRXhbQ6gXwpjCb_jtNRKA7waqXzMcnbqQPSQwS55nWfOPly0DoHVbv2UYpSC3Mw41yb-4JCeFY8MAQlM1Bf_tRhHDs0NXyw2oxfYBJhBHHZiMzCEN4UhbUYGu3gvYM7hqhecrzTb_WUYc0uFzVMeENQ%3D%3D) ** Sam will never lack the will, the hope, or the strength to keep going. **__[_But we need YOUR help to have the resources keep our operation moving._](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=378561c5fa8a49dcb7cabf8f4b4bfc6d&_e=MUzVNFKY9O7vqEtp13E0depl6NLLrqxXDo50y6M_ZtWy1IvZLd8rf8b04GJlM_MNTk7LMF99BHJvRFrGrhfuuNSR0uoyuvjDP7E78iQLq2C6m-ycKPbO0Ef5f5ZX4f8m5E68DGz7eUYpsD88jVDKpJMFcf2a5jO6ZvrGHKQ_IlrPVg3J2AXbj0j17Oyz7dFcgSZUs7N46bOPsQfouxUWLwwK9LP3J9vKWcX3eF7IOjCP83q61wNoH6u_j43kUgrZ6C2yFN6gXdg_kOyYKVpZgfzSewxTWTN3HUqeaV06JdYfJhmcEEkpJ9vTJd2LfLSi1K_NBuQtOXnG7w1UfyboSGnMWKekD2B9mXUG4MwtYJNh7MPQUfj0VYCv2K7_u-4YYEsHoh8m9lBQtAI6jXyrKe7pUTCoQjgD4AFiaLUzOfMluOMSGFVo9rKKKyzpqW0jbQK8O-rp3vFa6DbMcEKpRw%3D%3D)** Today, Sam is working with every fiber of his being to win this Senate race. But the reality is that Chuck Schumer and the far-left Democrats know just how important this race is. My husband was given a new life by God that day on the battlefield. I was given a new life the day I met him. Friend, It could only be divine intervention that brought Sam and I together. I am confident that we were ultimately led here, to this new battlefield to save America. Even in his toughest tests, Sam has proven to be the leader we need in the Senate. I don’t know where I’d be without Sam today, but I’m so grateful that God put him in my life. **__[_Would you please consider supporting Sam today to help us secure America’s future for our children and yours?_](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=378561c5fa8a49dcb7cabf8f4b4bfc6d&_e=MUzVNFKY9O7vqEtp13E0depl6NLLrqxXDo50y6M_ZtWy1IvZLd8rf8b04GJlM_MNTk7LMF99BHJvRFrGrhfuuNSR0uoyuvjDP7E78iQLq2C6m-ycKPbO0Ef5f5ZX4f8m5E68DGz7eUYpsD88jVDKpJMFcf2a5jO6ZvrGHKQ_IlrPVg3J2AXbj0j17Oyz7dFcgSZUs7N46bOPsQfouxUWLwwK9LP3J9vKWcX3eF7IOjCP83q61wNoH6u_j43kUgrZ6C2yFN6gXdg_kOyYKVpZgfzSewxTWTN3HUqeaV06JdYfJhmcEEkpJ9vTJd2LfLSiLOIvsie88iL4pnV6k_3hXwLAca4e_TnrAKxQyvz8vz-7dSege-0gPoeed4e5171IWNvg4vJfpY5_t8_gjX_BuBF-gA2ThMu9CodEh87NLfqlQrVnfxRAmIDrMU4uUn4Cde6oNK9RuG_KBSWUQLM3zA%3D%3D)** Sincerely, Amy Brown

subject: My decision...

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1977%2E135344%2EaB_JES)

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240929-2-900&t=2&akid=1977%2E135344%2EaB_JES)
---
Friends --
While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails ahead of tomorrow's FEC deadline, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**
[**That is why I would love it if you would consider donating $3 or whatever you can to my campaign as we're now in the final sprint. Do it before our FEC deadline ends tomorrow.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240929-2-900&t=3&akid=1977%2E135344%2EaB_JES)**

A few
years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World
Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great
Reset initiative.

What is
their plan, and what does it mean for America?

founder and executive director of the Forum-wrote, "We need a

also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This
initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt
to impose global rule by so-called experts.

social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a

body:
We must choose a path to peace

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, When war criminal Benjamin Netanyahu spoke before the UN Assembly and claimed that there was a “missile in every kitchen” in Lebanon, the subtext of this absurd assertion was loud and clear – Israel will claim Hezbollah is using civilians as “human shields” as cover to expand their genocidal killing spree to Lebanon with impunity, just as they’ve done to excuse their massacres of civilians in Gaza. Shortly after that speech on Friday, Israel dropped 87 tons of U.S. supplied bombs on the suburbs of southern Beirut, Lebanon, assassinating Hezbollah Secretary General Hasan Nasrallah and a yet undetermined number of innocent civilians. This isn’t the first political assassination carried out during this nearly year long terror campaign by Israel. In July, Israel assassinated Hamas’ chief negotiator, Ismail Haniyeh in Iran. Nasrallah’s assassination will certainly add yet more fuel to the fire burning out-of-control in the Middle East. Kamala Harris’ response to this dangerous escalation was swift – she praised the assassination of Nasrallah, claiming that “today Hezbollah’s victims have a measure of peace” while reiterating her “unwavering support” to Israel, assuring that she will continue to provide them with U.S. weapons and billions upon billions of U.S. tax dollars to fund their carnage across the region. Just last week, the Biden-Harris administration approved another 8.7 billion dollar weapons transfer to aid and abet Israeli war crimes.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lebanon_fundraising_9_29_pm&n=1)
---
What was missing from Kamala’s statement was any measure of concern for the people of Lebanon as they’re victimized by the kind of “shock and awe” bombing campaigns reminiscent of George W. Bush and prominent Kamala Harris endorser Dick Cheney in the early 2000s when they launched their illegal invasion of Iraq.
In fact, even George W. Bush demonstrated more concern for the loss of 12 innocent lives in 2002, when he condemned a residential bombing in the West Bank that assassinated a leader of Hamas. At least 1000 people have been killed since Israel started its onslaught of violence in Lebanon two weeks ago, and the death toll of this most recent bombing of six residential buildings is still unknown as teams comb through the rubble for human remains. Biden and Harris are following Netanyahu headlong into an escalating cycle of violence that can only lead to more war, death, and suffering. As Israel slaughters tens of thousands of innocent civilians with full US backing, they are creating more enemies than they can ever assassinate. Jill Stein and Butch Ware are the only candidates with a path to the White House who will stop this military madness on day one by cutting off all US arms and funding to Israel to force an immediate ceasefire and end to the illegal occupation of Palestine.[_**

Peter, we have just over a month to get the word out to voters everywhere that they have an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency ticket to vote for in Stein/Ware. Can you dig deep today to make sure that we can amplify their voices and break the death grip the duopoly has on U.S. politics?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lebanon_fundraising_9_29_pm&n=2)
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lebanon_fundraising_9_29_pm&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=lebanon_fundraising_9_29_pm&n=3)
---
As we move closer to the election, we’ll surely be hearing more propaganda about a vote for Jill and Butch being a “wasted” vote. But to vote for the duopoly candidates of war and Wall Street is to sign off on the ever-growing threat that all our futures will be wasted in a catastrophic WWIII mushroom cloud. Only a vote for Stein/Ware can take us off this deadly track and help bring a lasting peace. Thank you for your support. Together we’re an unstoppable force for people, planet and peace. In solidarity and gratitude, Team Jill Stein and Butch Ware

It is our FINAL quarterly fundraising deadline before November 5th. And after this deadline, we are legally required to report our numbers for public view. Dear Peter,
In his recent interview with Donald Trump Jr., Robert F. Kennedy Jr. went where every politician in America has refused to go–questioning where the high rise in Autism came from.
Here is what RFK Jr. dared to say out loud...
_A journalist did a study on Lancaster, Pennsylvania, and the Amish community. There should be if it followed national trends, about 2,200 kids with autism in the Amish communities._
_They were able to find only three kids in the Amish community with autism, and all three of them were people who were children who the Amish had adopted after receiving their vaccines._
_This doesn't mean vaccines caused autism._
_But this example of healthy kids in the Amish population should be seriously studied because we know this population is not exposed to pharmaceutical drugs, to pharmaceutical interventions, and poisonous food._
We know you agree.

body:
These candidates need our support.
| | |
---
Friend,

When I won my first race in 2021, I became the first Black senator elected from Georgia, making me only the 11th Black senator in our nation's history – out of the roughly 2,000 senators who have ever served in the chamber.

This year, I’m so excited to see more Black candidates running to join me – and I’m counting on you to come through for them like you’ve always come through for me.
**[We have an historic opportunity to elect our first Black woman president and expand Black representation in the U.S. Senate. That’s why my team put together a list of Black Senate candidates who need our support to win – so if you can, will you split a donation between Colin Allred (D-TX), Angela Alsobrooks (D-MD), Lisa Blunt Rochester (D-DE), and my campaign before midnight?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93860921/501846924/83321320?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5449-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGM1MDQyMi04OTdlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CNV45DV2EEtKmn3lnu8eL-gIZLHLpFnCbx_L2uJ6Pek=)**
Every day, I'm focused on making life better for families all across our state and our country – and I know that’s the same perspective these candidates would bring to the Senate as well.

From fighting voter suppression to pushing gun violence reform and working to lower everyday costs for hardworking people, there are so many issues to tackle – and we need every single Democratic vote we can get to ensure we enact real, lasting progress for people all across America.

Republicans will be pulling out all the stops in the final weeks before Election Day to attack these candidates and hand the majority back to the GOP – but I know that with the support of this grassroots team, our candidates can run strong campaigns, fight back against any attacks, and win these races.

**[So please, I hope you’ll split a donation today between Colin Allred (D-TX), Angela Alsobrooks (D-MD), Lisa Blunt Rochester (D-DE), and my campaign so we can expand Black representation in Congress and defend our Democratic Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93860922/501846925/83321320?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk5449-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMGM1MDQyMi04OTdlLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CNV45DV2EEtKmn3lnu8eL-gIZLHLpFnCbx_L2uJ6Pek=)**

Thanks for your support.

– Rev. Raphael Warnock

name: Ken Burns
subject: Requesting support
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]
Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges — from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:

* * *
I’ve spoken to so many young people who feel disillusioned — with politics, with leaders who don’t seem to listen to their concerns, and with the state of our world.
I understand why young people are really angry, and really hurting. But we can’t let that anger turn into apathy. What I want to say to young people is this: _Do not sit this election out._
We don’t have time to wait for perfect candidates or perfect policies. We need to push those in power to act on climate, and that starts by voting for the candidates who will give our movement a _voice._
If we stay home this November — if we don’t fight back — we’re handing the keys back to Donald Trump and the oil barons who he takes his orders from. **We won’t have a voice.**
We are facing a climate emergency. Scientists have repeatedly warned that if we don’t cut greenhouse gas emissions by half in the next decade, we are heading toward catastrophe. Vital ecosystems will be destroyed, millions will die or be displaced, and our chances of securing a livable future will be all but dead. And we know who’s at the helm of this crisis — the fossil fuel industry and the politicians that enable them.
Listen, I’ve spent more than five decades fighting for change — from protesting the Vietnam War to putting my body on the line for the climate movement.
History shows us that we need millions of people in the streets, but we also need people in the halls of power with ears and a heart to hear the protests, to hear the demands. Your vote and your voice are how we get those leaders who will listen — and act.
**That’s the work I set in motion three years ago when I launched the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. JanePAC is laser-focused on electing climate champions who are committed to a livable future.[Our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before the election is tomorrow at midnight, and we’re falling short of the $70,000 needed to meet our financial obligations. name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: The Power of Rural Democrats
body:
Local parties are coming together like never before to build a rural resurgence.
| | | | | |
---
# Rural Democrats Are Being Heard.
---
|
---
The pandemic changed so much for so many Americans. There are a few silver linings amongst those clouds. The world learned how to be more digitally connected and connected across great distances. Rural America is all about great distances. For years, political organizing was an insurmountable challenge in certain districts. Upon No Dem Left Behind's founding, we recognized that obstacle and had a plan to address it. Our early virtual town halls utilized celebrity star-power to spotlight Dems in deep-red districts. Our ROCC forums taught the principles of organizing in a peer-learning environment. Our work on ARPA inspired activism in Republican-led counties. In short, our mission was to connect and empower rural Democrats to build the infrastructure to reshape the Electoral Map in the years to come.
---
|
---
The lesson? After the rain, comes flowers.
---
|
---
It's a pleasure to have you with us in this ongoing journey. And that's how rural Democrats are feeling. Our reward at No Dem Left Behind comes when we step into that local Dems meeting, when we partner and accomplish something together, we get that great, big "thank you". Thanks for recognizing us, remembering us, and making sure we never feel left behind. If you can spare a little to support this work, we'd greatly appreciate it...
---
| | | | | [→ Support Rural Democrats](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uwzuw-f5nm2b-kyd76rh1/)
---
To tomorrow's field of flowers. — No Dem Left Behind

body:

| | In case you missed it, Google recently removed the PragerU app from the Play Store without warning. Only after our app disappeared from Google’s platform did they bother to notify us that it had been suspended and removed indefinitely for “Violation of Hate Speech.”

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=5d61ed4eae8244fba575e6596171a7b5&_e=z3QqiLFqShx8hNcyEuRC0h_11l_pZwnawaMgHSUpuazGMf8wI7sASDYcQ4GRZQkeH2AWki8f_iQ9aLBgTGj7vo2ev6iZIQvTp3eoo9zS-2q6ovgSSo0GwxZqwhRmTgFrJQoFfRsjccknwoEqTQeWot7Qy4xAjDZ8XbgeCW03hAqM9DymuxgbAEfuhwdHI0t76v3nvnC8DR0dIOeaFzhWp3jCz3aI-_eXzwU2zMRWGYxVUMgFYogLp_kyGfew2BMhGUGTWRcLa3_gonnFS5-RhQ%3D%3D)

According to Google, sharing the stories of a former Palestinian refugee, an Arab Muslim born in Israel, and brave U.S. Navy SEALs who witnessed the horrors of Muslim extremism constitutes “hate speech.” **Dear Infidels** went viral on social media, reaching millions of people! Like clockwork, Big Tech reared its ugly head to shut us down and suppress our reach. We immediately jumped into action and began sounding the alarm. Thanks to our dedicated followers and supporters, Big Tech did NOT win, and their Soviet-style censorship tactics were thwarted. After major outcry from our supporters and several media outlets, Google put the PragerU app back on the Google Play Store...for now. Unfortunately, we know this won’t be the last time we are targeted by Big Tech giants. It is imperative that we keep fighting for our freedoms. **[**At PragerU, we always fight back, but we need your help.**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=5d61ed4eae8244fba575e6596171a7b5&_e=z3QqiLFqShx8hNcyEuRC0h_11l_pZwnawaMgHSUpuazGMf8wI7sASDYcQ4GRZQkeH2AWki8f_iQ9aLBgTGj7vo2ev6iZIQvTp3eoo9zS-2q6ovgSSo0GwxZqwhRmTgFrmrubanVlmZsWMOz-7e9-0ZQQGfMjkZCvRrQauXva2UpJMAlRgFip0s_wUGK_yb75eW0o0xhShgHCyAf7fXZmZty-q8ChWvJ4xKsjdXojsWpmAKm5eSaj-_ujERtbbq6onDsnsQUwc1OJaaXj8y4x8w%3D%3D)** This is a David vs. Goliath battle. Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges — from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:
**[Can I count on you to contribute $5, $20 or whatever feels right to you today directly to Adam Schiff and Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan? Last week, we shared a heartbreaking and truly infuriating story about a woman in Georgia who tragically died due to lack of access to modern, standard reproductive healthcare. Doctors let Amber Thurman, a 28-year-old mother of a six-year-old boy, suffer in pain **for 20 hours** before they finally intervened – by then, it was too late.

Another pregnant mother, Candi Miller, was too afraid to even enter a hospital because she understood that Georgia’s abortion ban might criminalize her or any doctors who tried to help her. Her death has left three young children in Georgia without a mother.

**Here is a look at some of our Georgia candidates:**

**✅ Debra Shigley for Georgia State House Representative District 47:** Debra is a mother of five, an attorney, and a former news anchor. Her opponent is an extremely conservative woman named Jan Jones, who has recently been endorsed by “Frontline Policy Action,” an organization that advocates for __biblical values__ and supports candidates who would affirm those values in office. **Her opponent helped to push through the 6-week abortion ban currently in place in Georgia.**

**✅ Danielle Bell for Georgia State House of Representatives District 44:** Danielle is a military wife, the mother of young children, a social worker, and a small business owner. She plans to promote equality in education, healthcare, and economic opportunities. She told us she’d start by advocating for policies that can address the maternal healthcare crisis in Georgia and restore abortion access. **She is running against a man who has been in this seat for nearly 30 years – since 1995 – who voted in support of the 6-week abortion ban in Georgia.**

**✅ Susie Greenberg for Georgia State House of Representatives District 53:** Susie has a 40-year history of fighting for women's healthcare and reproductive rights. Beginning in college in the 1980s, she was a patient escort for a reproductive healthcare clinic and worked through the decades as a strong advocate, including serving as a board member of Planned Parenthood Southeast and NCJW Atlanta. She is running to unseat an anti-choice Republican incumbent Representative who has repeatedly failed to protect women and doctors in Georgia. **_This is the top target race in the state_ and _our best chance_ of replacing an anti-choice legislator in Georgia’s House of Representatives.**

**We are ready to turn our outrage into action, and we hope you’ll join us:**

body:
| | | Politics is personal, Peter — so this year, WFP members across the country are putting their personal touch on our Get Out the Vote efforts by sending free postcards with their photo to their friends, family, and loved ones. The WFP postcard program is a quick and easy way to have a major impact on elections up and down the ballot. Can we count on you to join us? **[Click here to RSVP for a virtual Selfie Postcard Workshop TONIGHT, Sunday, September 29 at 7 PM ET/4 PM PT.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxK1N_7cYoMxrGiNmK5EGvDwVYVflR4N5BjWiJtrwzsx-jLC456qiio2zUq7hikKJRZ-eXqurR1RgwtSkn2YTI4ij7xFUI6WxVYnQl2L8O351Gr84pZp412KJfS-ZJEVNvevFFIHeq3ea-4By7xXdE9bzEQ8df_jJ_N2ZTDz4XbMyei_DjlGoGiPBNo7wVp6qFcq81oCzktGZLl4xt0zGbdBUpuOZBlVVKIa_X8MdtY7brXFklxkPDPosRCmvfYeniZd3HIivIoEoco9B27_9UOw/4a6/xKjKwBNJR_yVpN1njj6sPA/h0/h001.2_BJvthhaMWojxBlTIi3rk834MINIuNjgJBQOKootm8)** At the workshop, our organizers will walk you through how to use the REACH app to upload your photo and share who in your life you’d like to receive your postcard with voter information. After that, you’re done! **We’ll take care of all printing, postage, and mailing.** **[RSVP now](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMbGj-ca0TYSsYMZBvIweYdJxZAP5xLg1YZaKIinIFmIxK1N_7cYoMxrGiNmK5EGvDwVYVflR4N5BjWiJtrwzsx-jLC456qiio2zUq7hikKJRmhRLzxZxYj2XSrYezCEQfTjExa2Y-ZgCWWE86f05ND1FmzYjfXz8O80gUb1HtLaNQl_kP14JHDan18Zr7szilqJahM-c2OXhOfvveEnK33KnWUbw_W0R-jXc_0LdJI2-nRXhL5cNDGc6i0zzColqNryFE9b-MQ6nyFV1ptEp1ulLD21psP34fyz0WsrBdJR5tiQkF4ZK_oD80i4Qj90vaA/4a6/xKjKwBNJR_yVpN1njj6sPA/h1/h001.Yz1P6CarN5i7seBTG7WekGanbn0v2jKVqeQ16IdmepE)** To elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, as well as WFP champions fighting to make a difference in all of our communities, we’re using every tool in the toolbox — and one of the most effective tools we’ve found is personal outreach to your network. **By sending a free selfie postcard to the people in your life, Peter, you’re reminding them that you are counting on them to make their voices heard this election season.** We’re building momentum fast. Since we launched our 2024 postcard program earlier this month, the number of people who will be receiving postcards has increased 10x from previous elections, and over 1500 volunteers have taken action from swing states alone. **[Peter, we want you to be a part of this movement and help get people to the polls before this election is over. The WFP postcard program is a quick and easy way to have a major impact on elections up and down the ballot. Can we count on you to join us? body:
And I'm not willing to sit on the sidelines in this election.
#
[ ](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74324?refcode=em20240929-7853&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7853%2E614464%2ECSTlui)
Hi Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
I’m a born-and-raised Missourian who watched with horror when Josh Hawley raised his fist at insurrectionists outside the U.S. Capitol on January 6th, then ran out the back door when they stormed the building later that day.
I’ve seen communities across my home state torn apart because of cowardly politicians like him — and I’m not willing to sit on the sidelines in this election.
So before I ask you to [**make a donation of $10 or whatever you can today toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to replace Josh Hawley,**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74324?refcode=em20240929-7853&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7853%2E614464%2ECSTlui) please let me tell you why:
**[SUPPORT LUCAS KUNCE →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74324?refcode=em20240929-7853&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7853%2E614464%2ECSTlui)**
Most of my family is from a town in Missouri called Ste. Genevieve, about 60 miles south of St. Louis. I’ve watched their community go downhill for years.
While corrupt politicians shipped jobs overseas and voted to give handouts to Wall Street and their corporate allies, everyday people just trying to survive in the place they call home ran out of money and opportunities.
**Our leaders abandoned them — and Josh Hawley is the perfect example.**
Instead of fighting for what would make the communities in my home state stronger, Josh Hawley has been busy engaging in the out-of-touch culture wars that only divide us — all so he can get more and more power for himself.
That’s what we saw on January 6th, 2021. Hawley raised his fist at rioters outside the Capitol because he thought it would make him look strong. But when sh*t got real, he ran out the back door like a coward — away from the same people he was claiming to support just hours earlier.
What’s even more ridiculous? Since that day, Hawley has desperately tried to convince all of us that he’s the authority on what it means to be a man in this country. He even published a whole book about it last year:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74324?refcode=em20240929-7853&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7853%2E614464%2ECSTlui)
Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can write a book about.
Missouri is the Show Me State. Courage is something you have to show us.
**That’s why I’m supporting Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.** As a born-and-raised Missourian who joined the Marines to serve the community that took care of him growing up, Lucas has already shown us that he knows the true meaning of courage.

Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges -- from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:

In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens. Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it." But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall. There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official. I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. Peter -
My name is Aquilino Gonell. I served this country for half of my life, first in the Army and then as a United States Capitol Police Sergeant.
And I had to fight for my life at the Capitol on January 6th while it was under attack from insurrectionists inspired by people like Kari Lake.
**I am writing because inciting, cheering, and making excuses for an attack on our democracy should not be a prerequisite or credential to be in Congress or any position of trusted authority.**
But Kari Lake has used lies and conspiracies around January 6th to elevate her candidacy and build credibility with the far-right and Trump’s MAGA supporters.
That’s why I am personally writing to ask for your help, to send a message that we cannot allow insurrectionist-cheerleaders to get into the United States Senate.
Please:
[**Can you make a contribution to Ruben Gallego’s campaign for Senate in Arizona?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-eoq-sept24.AGNFt5&refcode=em240929-4-160&t=2&akid=3226%2E734936%2E1h5JnR)

Kari Lake has insinuated that the insurrection at the Capitol was a “false flag” set up by the FBI.
I was there. You saw it happen. These were not FBI agents. They were Trump fanatics, and they were ready to storm the Capitol on his orders. More than 1100 of them have been charged with crimes like assault and seditious conspiracy.
I can assure you they were not spreading the word of God as they cursed at law enforcement officers and assaulted us with multiple weapons. I wonder how Christian and loving the invading rioters were as they threatened to shoot me, and said that I, an Army veteran and police officer, should be executed.
**These attacks were inspired by lies told by far-right leaders like Kari Lake. Dozens of officers were seriously injured. People died.**

Hey, it’s Wes Share, Kirsten Engel’s finance director.
We’re working as hard as we can at Engel HQ to hit our quarterly fundraising goal — and apparently, it’s starting to show. Kirsten snapped this picture of me at my desk today:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_092924_EOQ_J_Wes_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_092924_EOQ_J_Wes_act]
From the start, I knew this was a race where every dollar in the door would matter.
When Kirsten lost in 2022, she had been outspent 6:1 by her opponent. That wasn’t because of grassroots support on his side. It was because of massive super PACs who spent big to buy a seat in Congress.
Kirsten refuses to take a dime from corporate PACs. So, for this whole campaign, we’ve relied on donors like you to keep us going — and it’s worked. We outraised our opponent the last two quarters!
But now, Ciscomani has out-of-state organizations pouring millions and millions of dollars into this race.
We have to raise at least $25,000 before tomorrow to keep up.

We have recruited the most robust class of GOP Senate candidates I’ve ever seen. We have an incredible group of America First fighters who know what it takes to win a U.S. Senate election and are COMMITTED to work their hardest to win.

[**Can you support our team before the quarter is up?**](http://links.action.supportstevedaines.com/u/click?_t=71faa67ca88f4c4b899697b6a4621901&_m=1e452b8474194dba89291a80c273704c&_e=r11pXoaeP-_cagB1oN-RvX9W4BVSOJoqiMFYVYZ621LoxFPHNEqKleaR56c4aqJlyn8ogYUFJ1utOLWqaqpY0XfSmMOjdYqcCF8IhF1Qyr561x-La5jTydSqZfJ5MH-aFrOVD2Ez5XPNBfvXIlm1cmdYEs6jAHHkCpks06sOQcpLqViSYDPIybIb9SSi46VdP-tJcS_95d1rTaFYHV6t0DZhzfTD8f8i_OklFqiIBzvbJuFRVv2NeWLv9A_1zqiFvRo1KKEqta_aU0p2qF46VJkXiP30L2EfI9zLtx23-GFhuAn5JSmKdO7vEykIbIqrsuOlDnH0nghUQ6XMNqOwqYyUpHXt8nvR54yoTL5Y7KFyfxd1MKetZEtu3_cJ4sh_)

Some seats where we have the best chance to win and FLIP from BLUE to RED are in **Ohio, Pennsylvania, Montana, Arizona, Nevada, and Wisconsin.** How I see the Senate map is this:

In Montana, former Navy SEAL _**Tim Sheehy**_ is taking on the NUMBER ONE recipient of lobbyist cash, Senator Jon Tester.

In Ohio, successful businessman _**Bernie Moreno**_ is taking on far-left Senator Sherrod Brown, who would be the deciding vote to make Chuck Schumer Majority Leader in the Senate.

In Arizona, America First warrior _**Kari Lake**_ is taking on self-proclaimed progressive Ruben Gallego for the open seat after incumbent Kyrsten Sinema (I-AZ) bowed out of seeking re-election.

In Nevada, Army veteran _**Sam Brown**_ is taking on Democrat Senator Jacky Rosen. Last cycle, Republicans were severely outspent by the liberal money machine in Nevada, Sam needs our help to make sure this doesn’t happen again.

In Pennsylvania, Gulf war veteran _**Dave McCormick**_ is taking on Liberal Senator Bob Casey in what will surely be a closely contested race that the media calls Casey’s "toughest race yet."

In Wisconsin, successful businessman _**Eric Hovde**_ is taking on Democrat Tammy Baldwin. Baldwin’s liberal allies are already attacking Hovde in ads airing across the state.

In Michigan, veteran _**Mike Rogers**_ is taking on Elissa Slotkin in a key race to flip – where he is being outraised in this close race. Mike needs you in his corner to ensure this race goes red.

On October 1, CBS is hosting the first (and only) VP debate between Tim Walz and JD Vance. Already, CBS has announced that it will _not live_ fact check either candidate. This is a travesty for the American people and a failure of the purpose of media. But we are not helpless to the failures of Legacy Media. We can and must act. Here's how. **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b64ec00d-45d7-43ca-a9ee-0478faf716dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Tim Walz (left) who previously served as a public school teacher and JD Vance (right), who previously referred to Trump as "America's Hitler."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..EwVuCHOuZMWFyOvlMkIpJ69fGXJsFwTl11JiJt66Ikg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149580493)
I am reminded of the evergreen wisdom of Sally Claire, who said:
> If someone says it's raining, and another person says it's dry, it's not your job to quote them both. Your job is to look out the fu**ing window and find out which is true."
Unfortunately, CBS has preemptively decided to absolve itself of the fundamental purpose of media--find out and report what is true. The AP reports, [that](https://substack.com/redirect/8b84a301-f7a2-4c0a-a0c0-005548d3a8db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "_CBS said the onus will be on Vance and Walz to point out misstatements by the other, and that "the moderators will facilitate those opportunities" during rebuttal time_." It is no wonder why Gallup reports that [public trust in media is at record lows](https://substack.com/redirect/815d14d0-d301-40f6-b96f-c0379dc1f934?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Much of that distrust has to do with media capitulating to the whims of corrupt politicians, rather than fulfilling their obligation to the American people of reporting facts.
CBS misses the point that the American people need a trusted third party to verify which politician is lying and which politician is truthful. That third party is supposed to be the journalists moderating the debate. Instead, this CBS decision to abscond from their responsibility comes after massive right wing backlash to the ABC moderated Harris/Trump debate. In that debate, ABC moderators live fact-checked Trump on his lies about immigration, immigrants eating dogs and cats, and on healthcare. ABC did the right thing in calling out these dangerous lies, and our country and democracy benefitted from upholding truth. But this is also why it is so perplexing that CBS is capitulating under right wing pressure.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..EwVuCHOuZMWFyOvlMkIpJ69fGXJsFwTl11JiJt66Ikg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149580493)
In the Spring, during the disastrous CNN debate between Biden and Trump, I called out the utter failure of Jake Tapper and Dana Bash to uphold truth, [writing](https://substack.com/redirect/76a15012-adc3-4283-b09a-b84f3457c336?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602f694e-45ce-42d1-ada9-d00dc62e8865?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Indeed, a free press is recognized as "the fourth estate" for a reason. And that reason is, to hold those in power accountable. If media fails (or refuses) to hold government accountable, then it fails to be a free press, and instead becomes state run propaganda. Adding to the irony of CBS refusing to live fact check the VP debate, is that CBS is [simultaneously running a story](https://substack.com/redirect/deae10f9-9aa9-4854-80ad-7ffec18f5afd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on how other nations teach their youth how to identify hoaxes, scams, and propaganda as a civic skill.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8fbaffc3-06d6-45b5-8562-c99f92d6e6f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Clearly, CBS understands the civic value in rebutting falsehood with truth, they just don't see the value in actually practicing what they preach. But we cannot sit helpless at the failures of legacy media. We can and must uphold democracy ourselves, and that begins by not being bystanders.
This is one major reason why I've launched _Let 's Address This_, and **why I will be broadcasting during the VP debate to live fact check.** Yes, I will also provide a detailed written fact check post debate, but I also invite you subscribe and tune in for the live discussion and dialogue, and immediate post-debate live discussion. The late great John Lewis reminds us that democracy is not a state, it is an act. Let us take action and protect our democracy by upholding truth and justice above politics and partisanship. I hope you'll consider subscribing and/or joining me Tuesday night, October 1 at 9pm EST.

Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges — from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
I also have a personal connection to this race. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:
Can I count on you to contribute $5, $20, or whatever feels right to you today directly to Tobias Read and Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan? I would not be reaching out were it not so important. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24-slotkin?refcode=240929em-kenburns]

Peter, I remember exactly where I was — driving to work after coffee and breakfast at Eddie’s Place — when I heard _Roe v. Wade_ had been overturned. I thought I was ready to hear it. I’d worked hard to prepare myself for the shock, but the news still hit me like a punch in the gut. I pulled my car to the side of the road, and I cried. For a time, I comforted myself in the knowledge that, in North Carolina, our freedom was still safe. Governor Cooper and his veto pen gave us protection from a GOP abortion ban. I even took a measure of pride as our state became a beacon of freedom; thousands of young women from across the South came to North Carolina for the care they were denied elsewhere. Then came another punch to the gut — this one from even closer to home. **State Rep Tricia Cotham switched parties from Democrat to Republican, giving NC Republicans the veto-proof supermajority they needed to rip away our freedom.** A few weeks later, Cotham cast the deciding vote to ban abortion in North Carolina. It’s hard to imagine a more powerful, self-serving betrayal. After months on the campaign trail praising _Roe v. Wade_ and promising to defend her fellow women’s freedoms, Cotham chose power over principle. She sold out her neighbors who voted for her, donated to her and campaigned for her. And she betrayed millions of North Carolinians, to serve her own political career. That’s when I decided to take action. **Now, I’m running for State Representative to defeat Tricia Cotham, break the Republican supermajority, and restore reproductive freedom in North Carolina.** **[If you would like to help us win, please split a donation between me and Wiley Nickel today. clean_body: | = Peter, I remember exactly where I was — driving to work after coffee and breakfast at Eddie’s Place — when I heard Roe v. Wade had been overturned. I thought I was ready to hear it. I’d worked hard to prepare myself for the shock, but the news still hit me like a punch in the gut. I pulled my car to the side of the road, and I cried. For a time, I comforted myself in the knowledge that, in North Carolina, our freedom was still safe. Governor Cooper and his veto pen gave us protection from a GOP abortion ban. I even took a measure of pride as our state became a beacon of freedom; thousands of young women from across the South came to North Carolina for the care they were denied elsewhere. Then came another punch to the gut — this one from even closer to home. State Rep Tricia Cotham switched parties from Democrat to Republican, giving NC Republicans the veto-proof supermajority they needed to rip away our freedom. A few weeks later, Cotham cast the deciding vote to ban abortion in North Carolina. It’s hard to imagine a more powerful, self-serving betrayal. After months on the campaign trail praising Roe v. Wade and promising to defend her fellow women’s freedoms, Cotham chose power over principle. She sold out her neighbors who voted for her, donated to her and campaigned for her. And she betrayed millions of North Carolinians, to serve her own political career. That’s when I decided to take action. **Polling shows that youth voter turnout INCREASES when there are young progressive candidates on the ballot.**
**We’ve been saying this from the start!** In a moment we’re going to explain what this poll means for youth voter turnout this year, but if you don’t have the time to read —**[please consider chipping in $5 before our September 30 end-of-quarter deadline to support the incredible work Leaders We Deserve has done uplifting and electing young progressives to office.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240929-2?refcode=em20240929-2&amount=5&refcode2=1232_587540_DQLV7Z&akid=1232%2E587540%2EDQLV7Z)**

These voters will be **_key_** if we’re going to stop Donald Trump and MAGA from retaking the White House this year.

If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8baebfd8cbd8400f9b1c6fe03b6778fb&_e=9Q5_lV0C47ux02f2KRZ_73QTowrAh8GLnNjIJzwFs11hki00BQx0WHKrLdW1OWvqPwEgyQuxDArnPWzB0zDUZoE3w6AoeBuJxSZ0tGrNWCgL8QvHCaT9OIkcFfpM2ZpJ_UXrQhq-ksFuLg8HyzypFyxdC8YLZWu6CIxibdZ4JsrVtBEYCvUhcP1Eyp4ITTX2UKu5EgrxePDqJ91mjd0NV4BL2KRJI413vVCqBr50q7w%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8baebfd8cbd8400f9b1c6fe03b6778fb&_e=9Q5_lV0C47ux02f2KRZ_73QTowrAh8GLnNjIJzwFs11hki00BQx0WHKrLdW1OWvqPwEgyQuxDArnPWzB0zDUZgUuS1rYsSofIgf8HHy2F8V5zWR2Q0YFb31ERMYRkabkDOxw8UbzUC9lTjTrtIaXynBXaIpmpzRSNb0Hhm4R5YdHgFcaTiChHf7wZGYOFqvfg_tqq_5o-UCMQRD8h-rOaQWemwBKwBDMSIvzOwENfuM%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. This will help us mobilize other patriots like you to help elect strong conservative leaders.

**2024 Senate Candidates**

Here’s the list of Senate candidates we are supporting this year — three incumbents and five challengers. ▶︎ Sen. Ted Cruz (TX) ▶︎ Sen. Rick Scott (FL)
▶︎ Sen. Josh Hawley (MO)
▶︎ Bernie Moreno (OH)
▶︎ Kari Lake (AZ)
▶︎ Sam Brown (NV)
▶︎ Tim Sheehy (MT)
▶︎ Eric Hovde (WI)

[**Contribute to these candidates through SCF so they have the funds to fight for our principles and win!**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=8baebfd8cbd8400f9b1c6fe03b6778fb&_e=9Q5_lV0C47ux02f2KRZ_73QTowrAh8GLnNjIJzwFs11hki00BQx0WHKrLdW1OWvqPwEgyQuxDArnPWzB0zDUZswYcluRZtbCuARsZk5qVbJsG3oic-xj8aaXMdMyeFP94hf9VP5ApKlbGxVkVj1CZNxmN0uVl9BydBHITg9k6RUsXdaYh21MOtfD3VnrdDdbDE2xyuu5kQSqzFOL3IR8MRck6FaNVZ6bPKNTPX0miIw%3D) The clock is ticking, so please take action today. _My mom and my sisters, watching me speak at the DNC this year._
Peter —
When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system to help me through.
Growing up the way I did, my mom raising my sisters and me on a single income, barely making ends meet — that wasn’t easy.
Working every job I could to support the family while I went to school and tried to get into college wasn’t easy.
Going out on patrol in al Anbar, at the height of the Iraq War sure wasn’t easy.
And now, running for Senate, having Donald Trump and Kari Lake relentlessly attack me, personally — that hasn’t been easy either.
But growing up, I had my family.
Getting into school, I had a strong community and great teachers.
In Iraq, I had my brothers.
And in this campaign, I have you.
I couldn’t do this without you, Peter. You probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking you were going to make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat Trump and Kari Lake and defend Arizona.
[**Peter, can you make your first $5 contribution to my campaign before this September FEC deadline hits tomorrow night? clean_body: My mom and my sisters, watching me speak at the DNC this year. Peter — When I think about the toughest times in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a support system to help me through. Growing up the way I did, my mom raising my sisters and me on a single income, barely making ends meet — that wasn’t easy. Working every job I could to support the family while I went to school and tried to get into college wasn’t easy. Going out on patrol in al Anbar, at the height of the Iraq War sure wasn’t easy. And now, running for Senate, having Donald Trump and Kari Lake relentlessly attack me, personally — that hasn’t been easy either. But growing up, I had my family. Getting into school, I had a strong community and great teachers. In Iraq, I had my brothers. And in this campaign, I have you. I couldn’t do this without you, Peter. You probably didn’t wake up this morning thinking you were going to make a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat Trump and Kari Lake and defend Arizona.
